creators.name: Steve Mann
creators.role: Wearable-computing pioneer; professor at the University of Toronto (EyeTap, mediated reality)
creators.bio: Built and wore head-mounted computers and cameras from the late 1970s onward, streamed his life from a Wearable Wireless Webcam in 1994 at MIT, and invented the EyeTap, which turns the eye itself into a camera and display. He coined 'mediated reality' and 'sousveillance' and keeps teaching wearable AR at the University of Toronto.
creators.why: He treated AR not as adding labels but as computationally rewriting what the eye sees (diminishing, amplifying, making invisible waves visible), decades before smart glasses existed.
creators.role_zh: 可穿戴计算先驱；多伦多大学教授（EyeTap、介导现实）
creators.bio_zh: 从 70 年代末起就自己制作并长期佩戴头戴式计算机和摄像机；1994 年在 MIT 用“可穿戴无线网络摄像头”实时直播自己的生活；发明了 EyeTap，让眼睛本身同时成为摄像机和显示器。他提出了“介导现实”（mediated reality）和“逆向监视”（sousveillance）等概念，至今仍在多伦多大学教授可穿戴 AR。
creators.why_zh: 早在智能眼镜出现几十年前，他就把 AR 理解为用计算重写眼睛所见：可以削弱、放大现实，也能让看不见的波动变得可见，而不只是往画面上加标签。

creators.name: Thad Starner
creators.role: Wearable-computing pioneer; professor at Georgia Tech; technical lead on Google Glass
creators.bio: Has worn a head-up display and one-handed Twiddler keyboard daily since 1993, co-founded the MIT wearable computing project, and runs the Contextual Computing Group at Georgia Tech. He was a technical lead and manager on Google Glass and works on sign-language recognition, passive haptic learning and head-worn assistants.
creators.why: He lived inside his own prototypes for decades, so his demos show what an always-on heads-up assistant is actually like in conversation, at work and at play.
creators.role_zh: 可穿戴计算先驱；佐治亚理工学院教授；Google Glass 技术负责人之一
creators.bio_zh: 自 1993 年起每天佩戴头戴显示器和单手 Twiddler 键盘，是 MIT 可穿戴计算项目的联合发起人，现主持佐治亚理工学院的 Contextual Computing Group。他曾担任 Google Glass 的技术负责人和经理，研究手语识别、被动触觉学习和头戴式智能助手。
creators.why_zh: 他几十年如一日“住”在自己的原型里，因此他的演示真实展现了一个始终在线的抬头助手在对话、工作和游戏中究竟是什么样子。

creators.name: Bruce Thomas — UniSA Wearable Computer Lab
creators.role: Professor; founder of the Wearable Computer Lab at the University of South Australia
creators.bio: Founded the Wearable Computer Lab at the University of South Australia, where Tinmith and ARQuake (with Wayne Piekarski) took AR outdoors around 2000. The lab later became a centre for spatial augmented reality: projecting interfaces onto foam, clay and mock-up control panels for design and prototyping.
creators.why: His lab kept asking how you would actually build, sculpt and prototype with AR, from backpack computers outdoors to projector-lit foam models on a workbench.
creators.role_zh: 教授；南澳大学可穿戴计算机实验室（Wearable Computer Lab）创始人
creators.bio_zh: 创建了南澳大学可穿戴计算机实验室。2000 年前后，实验室与 Wayne Piekarski 一起用 Tinmith 和 ARQuake 把 AR 带到了户外；之后又成为空间增强现实（SAR）的重镇，把界面投影到泡沫、黏土和控制面板模型上，用于设计和快速原型。
creators.why_zh: 他的实验室一直在追问“如何真正用 AR 来建造、雕塑和做原型”，从户外背包电脑一直做到工作台上被投影点亮的泡沫模型。

creators.name: Ruofei Du
creators.role: Interactive perception and graphics lead at Google XR
creators.bio: Researcher at Google who leads work on depth-based AR interaction (DepthLab, which shipped in the ARCore Depth API), AI-driven captions and agents for XR, and the open-source XR Blocks framework. Before Google he built mixed-reality social platforms such as Geollery at the University of Maryland.
creators.why: His projects turn raw perception (depth maps, speech, object detection) into a library of small, reusable AR interactions that others can copy.
creators.role_zh: Google XR 交互感知与图形研究负责人
creators.bio_zh: Google 研究员，主导基于深度的 AR 交互研究（DepthLab，已进入 ARCore Depth API）、面向 XR 的 AI 字幕与智能体，以及开源框架 XR Blocks。加入 Google 之前，他在马里兰大学做了 Geollery 等混合现实社交平台。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目把原始的感知数据（深度图、语音、物体识别）变成一套小巧、可复用的 AR 交互，别人拿来就能模仿。

creators.name: Alex Olwal
creators.role: Research scientist and tech lead at Google (AR, wearables, interaction)
creators.bio: Interaction researcher who built early spatial and mobile AR systems at KTH and Columbia, then worked at the MIT Media Lab and Google on wearables, captioning glasses and interfaces hidden in everyday materials.
creators.why: He repeatedly finds a small physical trick (a holographic window, a light sensor under a phone, a microphone array) that makes an AR idea work without heavy hardware.
creators.role_zh: Google 研究科学家、技术负责人（AR、可穿戴、交互）
creators.bio_zh: 交互研究者，早年在瑞典皇家理工学院（KTH）和哥伦比亚大学做空间 AR 与移动 AR 系统，之后在 MIT Media Lab 和 Google 研究可穿戴设备、字幕眼镜，以及隐藏在日常材料中的界面。
creators.why_zh: 他总能找到一个小小的物理巧思（全息窗口、手机下方的光传感器、麦克风阵列），不用笨重硬件就让 AR 想法成立。

creators.name: Mar Gonzalez-Franco
creators.role: Research scientist leading the Blended Interaction Research & Devices lab at Google (formerly Microsoft Research)
creators.bio: Neuroscientist and computer scientist who studied embodiment and avatars in VR, then led mixed-reality research at Microsoft Research before moving to Google. Her team explores AI agents, cross-device input and interaction with real objects in XR.
creators.why: She brings perception science into MR design: her demos exploit how attention, body ownership and space really work to make impossible interactions feel natural.
creators.role_zh: Google 研究科学家，领导 Blended Interaction Research & Devices 实验室（曾任职微软研究院）
creators.bio_zh: 神经科学与计算机科学背景，长期研究 VR 中的具身感与虚拟化身，曾在微软研究院主持混合现实研究，后加入 Google。她的团队探索 XR 中的 AI 智能体、跨设备输入以及与真实物体的交互。
creators.why_zh: 她把感知科学带进 MR 设计：她的演示利用注意力、身体归属感和空间感知的真实规律，让“不可能”的交互显得自然。

creators.name: Timoni West
creators.role: Designer; former head of XR research at Unity Labs (EditorXR, Carte Blanche, Unity MARS)
creators.bio: Led Unity Labs' XR research team, which prototyped authoring VR inside VR (EditorVR, Carte Blanche) and then Unity MARS, a tool for building AR apps that adapt to any real room. She speaks widely on designing tools for spatial computing.
creators.why: She focused on the tools rather than the apps: how non-programmers could author spatial content with their hands and how AR content can be described by rules about the room instead of fixed coordinates.
creators.role_zh: 设计师；曾任 Unity Labs XR 研究负责人（EditorXR、Carte Blanche、Unity MARS）
creators.bio_zh: 曾领导 Unity Labs 的 XR 研究团队，先后做了“在 VR 里编辑 VR”的原型 EditorVR 和 Carte Blanche，之后推出 Unity MARS：一个让 AR 应用自动适配任何真实房间的创作工具。她经常分享空间计算工具的设计思路。
creators.why_zh: 她关注的是工具而不是单个应用：非程序员如何用双手创作空间内容，以及如何用“关于房间的规则”而不是固定坐标来描述 AR 内容。

creators.name: SPACE10 (IKEA's research and design lab)
creators.role: Research and design lab funded by IKEA (2015–2023); producer of the Everyday Experiments series
creators.bio: IKEA's independent research lab in Copenhagen explored future living through food, architecture and technology until it closed in 2023. Its Everyday Experiments platform commissioned studios such as FIELD, Bakken & Bæck, Random Studio, Yuri Suzuki and Nicole He to prototype small spatial-computing ideas for the home.
creators.why: Everyday Experiments is a catalogue of short, playful 'what if' AR prototypes about ordinary domestic life, each one small enough to rebuild in a classroom.
creators.role_zh: IKEA 资助的研究与设计实验室（2015–2023），Everyday Experiments 系列的发起者
creators.bio_zh: IKEA 在哥本哈根设立的独立研究实验室，围绕食物、建筑和技术探索未来生活方式，于 2023 年关闭。它的 Everyday Experiments 平台邀请 FIELD、Bakken & Bæck、Random Studio、Yuri Suzuki、Nicole He 等工作室，为家居生活制作小型空间计算原型。
creators.why_zh: Everyday Experiments 是一套关于日常家居生活的“如果……会怎样”式 AR 原型合集，短小、好玩，每一个都小到可以在课堂上复刻。

creators.name: FIELD (FIELD.IO / FIELD.SYSTEMS)
creators.role: Creative studio for art, design and technology
creators.bio: Studio working with code, data, moving image and spatial experiences for clients and cultural projects. For IKEA and SPACE10's Everyday Experiments it built several LiDAR and AI-driven AR prototypes, from a room that plays music to elephants that measure your furniture.
creators.why: Their Everyday Experiments pieces take one childlike gesture (stacking, measuring, listening) and make it the whole AR interaction.
creators.role_zh: 艺术、设计与技术创意工作室
creators.based_zh: 伦敦，英国 / 柏林，德国
creators.bio_zh: 工作室用代码、数据、动态影像和空间体验为品牌和文化项目创作。为 IKEA 与 SPACE10 的 Everyday Experiments 制作了多个基于 LiDAR 和 AI 的 AR 原型，从会演奏房间的乐器到帮你量家具的大象。
creators.why_zh: 他们在 Everyday Experiments 中的作品都抓住一个孩子般的动作（堆叠、测量、聆听），并让它成为整个 AR 交互。

creators.name: Scatter / Depthkit (James George, Alexander Porter, Yasmin Elayat)
creators.role: Volumetric filmmaking studio and makers of the Depthkit capture software
creators.bio: Grew out of the open-source RGBDToolkit that paired a depth sensor with a DSLR. Scatter makes volumetric documentaries such as CLOUDS, Zero Days VR and The Changing Same, and sells Depthkit, the capture tool behind many volumetric AR and VR pieces, including Terminal 3.
creators.why: They made volumetric capture cheap enough for artists, which is why so many AR holograms of real people exist at all.
creators.role_zh: 体积影像工作室，Depthkit 捕捉软件的开发者
creators.bio_zh: 前身是把深度传感器和单反相机结合起来的开源工具 RGBDToolkit。Scatter 制作了 CLOUDS、Zero Days VR、The Changing Same 等体积影像纪录作品，并推出 Depthkit——许多体积 AR 和 VR 作品（包括 Terminal 3）背后的捕捉工具。
creators.why_zh: 他们把体积捕捉的门槛降到艺术家也用得起，如今才会有这么多“真人全息”的 AR 作品。

creators.name: Google ATAP (Advanced Technology and Projects)
creators.role: Google's hardware research group (Project Tango, Spotlight Stories, Soli, Jacquard)
creators.bio: Google's small, deadline-driven skunkworks, started from Motorola. Project Tango, led by Johnny Lee, put depth sensing and motion tracking into phones in 2014 and paved the way for ARCore; Spotlight Stories turned the phone into a window onto 360° animated films; Soli brought radar gestures into products.
creators.why: Project Tango was the first time a phone understood the room it was in, and most of today's phone AR descends from it.
creators.role_zh: Google 的硬件前沿研究部门（Project Tango、Spotlight Stories、Soli、Jacquard）
creators.bio_zh: Google 内部以短周期冲刺著称的小型研发团队，源自摩托罗拉。由 Johnny Lee 领导的 Project Tango 在 2014 年把深度感知和运动追踪装进手机，为 ARCore 铺平道路；Spotlight Stories 把手机变成观看 360° 动画短片的窗口；Soli 则把雷达手势带进了产品。
creators.why_zh: Project Tango 第一次让手机真正理解自己所处的房间，今天大部分手机 AR 都是它的后代。

creators.name: Eyal Ofek
creators.role: Computer vision and XR researcher (formerly Microsoft Research; now University of Birmingham)
creators.bio: Worked on the first real-time time-of-flight camera (ZCam), then spent many years at Microsoft Research on projector-camera systems, AR layout, haptic VR controllers and walking-based VR, co-authoring IllumiRoom and RoomAlive with Hrvoje Benko and Andy Wilson.
creators.why: His projects bend the real environment into the virtual one: re-laying out AR to fit a room, turning a walk down a street into a VR adventure, or hiding changes in plain sight.
creators.role_zh: 计算机视觉与 XR 研究者（曾任职微软研究院，现任伯明翰大学）
creators.bio_zh: 早年参与第一台实时飞行时间深度相机 ZCam，之后多年在微软研究院研究投影-相机系统、AR 布局、VR 触觉控制器和行走式 VR，与 Hrvoje Benko 和 Andy Wilson 合作了 IllumiRoom 和 RoomAlive。
creators.why_zh: 他的项目把真实环境“折叠”进虚拟世界：让 AR 布局自动适配房间，把一次街头散步变成 VR 冒险，或者在你眼皮底下悄悄改变场景。

creators.name: Asad J. Malik (1RIC / Jadu)
creators.role: AR director and founder of Jadu
creators.bio: Pakistani-born director whose studio 1RIC made volumetric AR narratives for HoloLens and Magic Leap that premiered at Tribeca and Sundance. He then founded Jadu, a multiplayer AR fighting game with holographic characters.
creators.why: He uses life-size volumetric people in your own room to make you uncomfortable in a meaningful way, turning AR into a medium for empathy and politics.
creators.bio_zh: 出生于巴基斯坦的导演，他的工作室 1RIC 为 HoloLens 和 Magic Leap 制作体积影像 AR 叙事作品，先后在翠贝卡和圣丹斯电影节首映。之后他创立了 Jadu，一款以全息角色对战的多人 AR 格斗游戏。
creators.why_zh: 他把真人大小的体积影像人物放进你自己的房间，让你产生有意义的不适感，把 AR 变成关于同理心和政治的媒介。

works.title: WearComp and the Wearable Wireless Webcam
works.description: A 1996 TV report follows Mann around MIT wearing a head-mounted display and camera wired to a backpack computer that streams what he sees to the web and overlays text in front of his eye.
works.description_zh: 1996 年的电视报道跟随 Mann 走在 MIT 校园里：他戴着头戴显示器和摄像头，连着背包电脑，把眼前所见实时传到网上，同时在眼前叠加文字信息。
works.idea_en: Wear the computer all day so that seeing, recording and sharing become one continuous act.
works.idea_zh: 把电脑穿在身上一整天，让“看见、记录、分享”变成同一个连续的动作。
works.technique: A self-built backpack computer drives a head-mounted display and a head-mounted camera, with a radio link uploading frames to a web page in near real time.
works.technique_zh: 自制的背包电脑驱动头戴显示器和头戴摄像头，通过无线电链路把画面近乎实时地上传到网页。
works.exercise_en: Wear a phone on a head strap for one hour and live-stream only what you look at to a shared page for classmates. Twist: let viewers send one-word messages that appear in your view.
works.exercise_zh: 用头带把手机固定在头上，戴一小时，只把你看着的画面直播到同学共享的页面。变体：让观众发送一个词的消息，显示在你的视野里。

works.title: EyeTap Digital Eye Glass
works.description: Mann explains the EyeTap: a beam splitter in front of one eye sends the exact rays entering the eye to a camera and re-emits processed light back along the same path, so the computer can replace what the eye sees.
works.description_zh: Mann 讲解 EyeTap：眼前的分光镜把本应进入眼睛的光线送进摄像头，再把处理后的光沿同一路径射回眼睛，于是计算机可以替换眼睛看到的内容。
works.idea_en: Make the eye itself the camera and the display, so the computer sees exactly what you see and can rewrite it.
works.idea_zh: 让眼睛本身同时成为摄像机和显示器，计算机看到的就是你看到的，并且可以改写它。
works.technique: A diverter mirror places the camera's centre of projection at the eye's own centre of projection, and an aremac (reverse camera) re-draws the processed image with correct parallax.
works.technique_zh: 分光镜让摄像机的投影中心与眼睛的投影中心重合，再由 aremac（“反向相机”）以正确的视差重绘处理后的图像。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone 'viewfinder eye': hold the phone in front of one eye and apply a live filter that changes one class of objects (text, faces, signs). Twist: close the other eye and walk a short path using only the mediated view.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机“取景器之眼”：把手机举在一只眼睛前，用实时滤镜改变某一类物体（文字、人脸、标志）。变体：闭上另一只眼，只靠被介导的画面走完一段短路。

works.title: Augmented/Mediated Reality Concepts
works.description: A short concept film from Mann's EyeTap lab showing a wearer whose glasses not only add information but also remove or replace things in view, such as blocking out advertising billboards in the street.
works.description_zh: Mann 的 EyeTap 实验室制作的概念短片：主角的眼镜不仅添加信息，还会删除或替换视野中的东西，比如把街上的广告牌遮掉。
works.idea_en: AR can subtract as well as add: diminished reality lets you filter the world you do not want to see.
works.idea_zh: AR 不只是做加法，也可以做减法：削弱现实让你过滤掉不想看到的世界。
works.technique: Likely tracked planar regions such as billboards are detected in the head camera feed and overwritten with other imagery before being shown to the eye.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是在头戴摄像头画面中检测出广告牌等平面区域，再在显示给眼睛之前用其他图像覆盖掉。
works.exercise_en: Use phone AR image tracking to detect one poster or logo on campus and cover it with a calm texture. Twist: replace every detected logo with a short personal note from a classmate.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR 的图像追踪识别校园里的一张海报或标志，并用平静的纹理把它盖住。变体：把识别到的每个标志换成一条同学写的私人留言。

works.title: OpenVIDIA: Mediated Reality on the GPU
works.description: Filmed through EyeTap glasses, a technician looks at equipment while GPU-processed overlays are positioned live on it, and a remote expert can guide the work visually.
works.description_zh: 透过 EyeTap 眼镜拍摄：技术人员看着设备，GPU 实时处理的叠加图像被准确地贴在设备上，远程专家可以通过画面指导操作。
works.idea_en: Use the graphics card as a vision processor so a wearable can register overlays on the world in real time.
works.idea_zh: 把显卡当作视觉处理器，让可穿戴设备能实时把叠加图像对准现实世界。
works.technique: The OpenVIDIA library runs feature tracking and image warping as GPU shaders, so homography-based registration keeps overlays locked to surfaces at video rate.
works.technique_zh: OpenVIDIA 库把特征追踪和图像变形写成 GPU 着色器，基于单应矩阵的配准能以视频帧率让叠加图像牢牢贴在表面上。
works.exercise_en: Pair two students: one points a phone at a device (a coffee machine, a printer) while the other, remote, draws arrows that stay anchored on it in phone AR. Twist: the remote helper may only draw one stroke per step.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组：一人用手机对准一台设备（咖啡机、打印机），另一人远程画箭头，箭头在手机 AR 中固定在设备上。变体：远程助手每一步只能画一笔。

works.title: HDR EyeGlass (welding helmet)
works.description: A welding helmet with a camera and display lets the welder see both the blinding arc and the dark metal around it clearly at the same time, by fusing several exposures in real time.
works.description_zh: 一个装有摄像头和显示器的焊接面罩，通过实时融合多张不同曝光的画面，让焊工同时看清刺眼的电弧和周围昏暗的金属。
works.idea_en: Give human vision a dynamic range it never had, so the brightest and darkest parts of a scene are visible together.
works.idea_zh: 赋予人眼从未有过的动态范围，让场景中最亮和最暗的部分同时可见。
works.technique: Frames with alternating exposures are combined with comparametric (quantigraphic) HDR compositing on the fly and tone-mapped to the head-worn display.
works.technique_zh: 交替曝光的画面通过 comparametric（quantigraphic）HDR 合成实时融合，再经色调映射显示在头戴屏幕上。
works.exercise_en: Point a phone at a window scene with a bright sky and a dark room, and build a live view that blends two exposures with a slider for the mix. Twist: map brightness to sound instead of image.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机对准一个既有明亮天空又有昏暗室内的窗景，做一个融合两种曝光的实时画面，并用滑杆调节混合比例。变体：把亮度映射成声音而不是图像。

works.title: HDRchitecture
works.description: A SIGGRAPH Emerging Technologies demo in which extreme-dynamic-range video from a wearable rig is combined with 3D sensing, so bright light sources and dark rooms are captured and seen together in real time.
works.description_zh: SIGGRAPH 新兴技术展演示：把可穿戴设备拍到的极高动态范围视频与 3D 感知结合，实时同时捕捉并呈现强光源和昏暗空间。
works.idea_en: Perceive a space's light and geometry at once, beyond what either an eye or a camera can see alone.
works.idea_zh: 同时感知空间的光与几何，超越单凭眼睛或相机所能看到的范围。
works.technique: GPU-based HDR fusion of bracketed exposures runs in real time and is mapped onto depth-sensed geometry for 3D viewing.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPU 实时融合包围曝光的画面，并映射到深度传感得到的几何体上进行 3D 观看。
works.exercise_en: Scan a room with a LiDAR phone twice, once with lights on and once with lights off, and toggle between the two meshes in AR. Twist: let a hand gesture paint 'daylight' onto parts of the dark scan.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机把同一个房间开灯和关灯各扫描一次，在 AR 中切换两个网格。变体：用手势把“日光”涂到黑暗扫描的某些部分。

works.title: SWIM: Sequential Wave Imprinting Machine
works.description: A robotic arm sweeps a row of LEDs through space while they light up with the live signal of a sound or radio wave, so a long-exposure camera or the eye's persistence of vision sees the invisible wave frozen in the air where it really is.
works.description_zh: 机械臂带着一排 LED 在空中扫动，LED 按声波或无线电波的实时信号亮起，于是长曝光相机或人眼的视觉暂留会看到这道看不见的波被“冻结”在它真实所在的空间位置上。
works.idea_en: Phenomenal augmented reality: make real physical phenomena, not graphics, visible exactly where they exist.
works.idea_zh: “现象级”增强现实：让真实的物理现象（而不是图形）在它存在的地方直接显现。
works.technique: A lock-in amplifier demodulates the wave relative to its source, and the LED bar's brightness at each position is driven by that signal while it moves, imprinting the standing wave in space.
works.technique_zh: 锁相放大器以波源为参考解调信号，LED 灯条移动时每个位置的亮度都由该信号驱动，把驻波“印”在空间里。
works.exercise_en: Tape a phone flashlight to a stick, make it blink with the loudness of a speaker's tone, and sweep it past the speaker in a dark room while another phone takes a long exposure. Twist: sweep at different distances and compare the patterns.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机闪光灯绑在一根棍子上，让它随扬声器声音的响度闪烁，在暗室里从扬声器前扫过，同时用另一部手机长曝光拍摄。变体：在不同距离扫动并比较图案。

works.title: Augmediated Reality with Depth-based Surface Tracking
works.description: An early Meta/EyeTap prototype in which a depth camera on the glasses tracks bare surfaces without markers, so virtual windows stay attached to a table or sheet of paper as the wearer moves.
works.description_zh: 早期 Meta/EyeTap 原型：眼镜上的深度相机无需标记就能追踪普通表面，让虚拟窗口在佩戴者移动时依然贴在桌面或一张纸上。
works.idea_en: Any plain surface can become a screen if the glasses understand its shape.
works.idea_zh: 只要眼镜理解了表面的形状，任何普通平面都能成为屏幕。
works.technique: Structure-based tracking fits planes to the depth map every frame and runs side by side with the rendering engine, so no visual features or fiducials are needed.
works.technique_zh: 基于结构的追踪在每一帧深度图上拟合平面，并与渲染引擎并行运行，因此不需要视觉特征或标记。
works.exercise_en: Use AR plane detection to pin a note app to a blank sheet of paper and let the sheet move. Twist: when the paper is folded, split the content across the two halves.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 平面检测把一个便签应用固定在一张白纸上，并让它随纸移动。变体：纸被折起来时，把内容分到两半上。

works.title: Doppler sonar vision system for the blind
works.description: A lab from Mann's wearable-computing course: a small sonar unit turns the Doppler shift of moving objects into audible tones, giving a sightless wearer a sense of motion around them.
works.description_zh: Mann 可穿戴计算课程中的实验：一个小型声呐装置把运动物体的多普勒频移转换成可听的声音，让看不见的佩戴者感知周围的运动。
works.idea_en: Hear motion: translate an invisible sensing channel directly into a sense you already have.
works.idea_zh: “听见”运动：把一种看不见的感知通道直接翻译成你已有的感官。
works.technique: An ultrasonic transmitter and receiver feed a homemade lock-in amplifier whose output frequency equals the Doppler shift, which is played through headphones.
works.technique_zh: 超声波发射器和接收器接入自制的锁相放大器，其输出频率等于多普勒频移，并通过耳机播放。
works.exercise_en: Use a phone's camera optical flow to turn the speed of moving things in front of you into pitch, then walk a hallway with eyes closed. Twist: map direction to left and right ears.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机摄像头的光流，把面前物体的运动速度转换成音高，然后闭着眼走一段走廊。变体：把运动方向映射到左右耳。

works.title: Underwater AR brain-sensing eyeglass
works.description: Mann swims in Lake Ontario wearing waterproof AR eyeglasses with a brain-sensing headband, capturing and overlaying information from below the waterline.
works.description_zh: Mann 戴着防水 AR 眼镜和脑电头带在安大略湖里游泳，在水面以下拍摄并叠加信息。
works.idea_en: Take wearable AR into water, where vision, sound and balance all behave differently.
works.idea_zh: 把可穿戴 AR 带进水里，那里的视觉、声音和平衡感都与陆地不同。
works.technique: Likely a sealed head-up display and camera paired with an EEG headband stream data to a waterproofed wearable computer.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是密封的抬头显示器和摄像头，加上脑电头带，把数据传给经过防水处理的可穿戴电脑。
works.exercise_en: Put a phone in a waterproof pouch, float it in a sink or pool and design an AR overlay that only makes sense underwater (depth, bubbles, refraction). Twist: make the overlay react to the water's movement.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机装进防水袋放进水槽或泳池，设计一个只在水下才有意义的 AR 叠加层（深度、气泡、折射）。变体：让叠加层随水的波动而变化。

works.title: Remembrance Agent
works.description: In a 1996 interview with Alan Alda, Starner types notes on a one-handed keyboard while his head-up display quietly shows one-line summaries of old files that relate to what is being said.
works.description_zh: 在 1996 年接受 Alan Alda 采访时，Starner 一边用单手键盘记笔记，一边在抬头显示器上悄悄看到与当下对话相关的旧文件的一行摘要。
works.idea_en: A just-in-time memory: the wearable listens to what you are doing and surfaces your own past notes without being asked.
works.idea_zh: 即时记忆：可穿戴设备根据你正在做的事，主动浮现你自己过去的笔记。
works.technique: A background process continuously runs text similarity search over the user's files against the last few typed lines and displays the best matches at the bottom of the HUD.
works.technique_zh: 后台进程不断用最近输入的几行文字，对用户的文件做文本相似度检索，并把最匹配的结果显示在抬头显示器底部。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone overlay that listens to speech, transcribes keywords and shows one matching line from a class notes file. Twist: allow only one suggestion per minute so it stays unobtrusive.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机叠加层：监听语音、提取关键词，并从课堂笔记文件中显示一条匹配的内容。变体：每分钟最多只显示一条建议，保持不打扰。

works.title: DUCK! wearable agent for Patrol
works.description: In Patrol, a dart-gun tag game played in MIT buildings, each player wears a computer; the DUCK! agent uses location and gesture recognition to show teammates' positions on a head-up map and flash when someone is vulnerable while reloading.
works.description_zh: Patrol 是在 MIT 楼里玩的软弹枪对战游戏，每名玩家都穿戴计算机；DUCK! 智能体通过位置和手势识别，在抬头地图上显示队友位置，并在有人换弹暴露时闪烁提示。
works.idea_en: Let a wearable read the game from your body so teammates get tactical information without talking.
works.idea_zh: 让可穿戴设备从你的身体动作读懂游戏，队友无需说话就能获得战术信息。
works.technique: Room-level location beacons and accelerometer gesture recognition detect firing and reloading, and the states are shared over the network to everyone's HUD.
works.technique_zh: 房间级定位信标和加速度计手势识别检测开火与换弹动作，状态通过网络共享到每个人的抬头显示器。
works.exercise_en: Run a hide-and-seek round where each phone uses its accelerometer to detect a 'crouch' and shares it to a team map. Twist: reveal a player's position only when they move fast.
works.exercise_zh: 玩一轮捉迷藏：每部手机用加速度计识别“蹲下”，并把状态共享到团队地图。变体：只有当玩家快速移动时才暴露他的位置。

works.title: ASL recognition from a wearable camera
works.description: A cap-mounted camera looks down at the wearer's hands while they sign American Sign Language sentences, and a recogniser turns the signs into English words in real time.
works.description_zh: 戴在帽子上的摄像头向下拍摄佩戴者的双手，当他用美国手语打出句子时，识别器实时把手势翻译成英语单词。
works.idea_en: Point the camera at your own hands so the wearable understands the language they speak.
works.idea_zh: 把摄像头对准自己的双手，让可穿戴设备读懂双手所说的语言。
works.technique: Hand blobs are tracked from the downward-looking camera and fed as features to hidden Markov models trained on sentence-level ASL.
works.technique_zh: 从向下拍摄的画面中追踪手部区域，作为特征输入到用句子级美国手语训练的隐马尔可夫模型中。
works.exercise_en: Use MediaPipe hand tracking on a phone worn on the chest to recognise five hand signs and speak them aloud. Twist: design a new five-sign vocabulary for controlling music.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机挂在胸前，用 MediaPipe 手部追踪识别五种手势并朗读出来。变体：为控制音乐设计一套新的五手势词汇。

works.title: Perceptive Workbench
works.description: A projection table that reconstructs objects placed on it in 3D, tracks pointing gestures above it and hosts an AR game against a remote player who wears a mobile computer.
works.description_zh: 一张投影桌：能对放在上面的物体进行 3D 重建，追踪桌面上方的指向手势，还能与一名穿戴移动计算机的远程玩家进行 AR 对战。
works.idea_en: A table that sees what you put on it and where you point, linking a desk to a player in the field.
works.idea_zh: 一张能看见你放了什么、指向哪里的桌子，把桌面和户外的玩家连接起来。
works.technique: Infrared illuminators under the surface and cameras cast shadows of objects and arms; silhouettes from several lights are intersected to reconstruct shape and arm direction.
works.technique_zh: 桌面下的红外光源和摄像头拍下物体和手臂的影子，再把多个光源下的剪影求交，重建出物体形状和手臂指向。
works.exercise_en: Build a projector-camera table with a cheap projector and a webcam that detects dark shapes placed on paper and draws outlines around them. Twist: link it to a phone player who sees the same shapes as obstacles.
works.exercise_zh: 用便宜的投影仪和网络摄像头做一张投影桌，识别放在纸上的深色物体并在周围画出轮廓。变体：把它连接到一名手机玩家，对方把这些形状看作障碍物。

works.title: Gesture Pendant
works.description: A pendant with an infrared camera and LEDs hangs on the chest; waving the hand in front of it controls lights and devices in the Georgia Tech Aware Home.
works.description_zh: 挂在胸前的吊坠里装有红外摄像头和 LED；在它前面挥手，就能控制佐治亚理工 Aware Home 里的灯光和设备。
works.idea_en: Wear the sensor instead of instrumenting the home: gestures travel with you.
works.idea_zh: 把传感器戴在身上，而不是装满整个房子：手势跟着你走。
works.technique: Self-illuminating infrared lights the hand so a small camera can segment it against any background, and simple gesture recognition maps motions to home-automation commands.
works.technique_zh: 自带红外照明把手照亮，让小摄像头在任何背景下都能分割出手部，再通过简单的手势识别映射到家居控制命令。
works.exercise_en: Hang a phone around your neck with the front camera facing out and map three hand shapes to smart-light colours. Twist: make one gesture only work while you look at the lamp.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机挂在脖子上、前置摄像头朝外，把三种手形映射成智能灯的颜色。变体：让某个手势只在你看着灯时才生效。

works.title: Dual Purpose Speech
works.description: While scheduling a meeting in conversation, the wearer phrases sentences like 'next Tuesday at three?' so that the other person hears a normal question and the wearable calendar hears a command.
works.description_zh: 在对话中约会议时，佩戴者说出诸如“下周二三点可以吗？”这样的句子：对方听到的是普通提问，可穿戴日历听到的却是一条指令。
works.idea_en: Speech that serves two listeners at once, the person and the computer, keeping interaction socially invisible.
works.idea_zh: 一句话同时说给两个听众：人和计算机，让交互在社交中变得不可察觉。
works.technique: A push-to-talk key marks the phrases to recognise, and a speech recogniser with a calendar grammar turns them into navigation of the head-up calendar.
works.technique_zh: 用一个按键标记需要识别的语句，语音识别器配合日历语法，把它们转换成对抬头日历的操作。
works.exercise_en: Design a voice UI for AR glasses where every command is also a natural sentence to a friend, and test it in a two-person role play. Twist: add a phrase that cancels without the friend noticing.
works.exercise_zh: 为 AR 眼镜设计一个语音界面，每条指令同时也是对朋友说的自然句子，并在两人角色扮演中测试。变体：加入一句能取消操作、而朋友察觉不到的话。

works.title: Mobile Music Touch
works.description: A fingerless glove vibrates each finger in the order of a piano melody while the wearer does other work; later they can play the tune on a keyboard without having practised.
works.description_zh: 一只无指手套按照钢琴旋律的顺序依次振动每根手指，佩戴者同时在做别的工作；之后他们无需练习就能在琴键上弹出这段旋律。
works.idea_en: Passive haptic learning: the body learns a skill while your attention is elsewhere.
works.idea_zh: 被动触觉学习：在注意力放在别处时，身体也能学会一项技能。
works.technique: Vibration motors on each finger are driven in time with a melody played through headphones, repeating in the background to train finger sequence memory.
works.technique_zh: 每根手指上的振动马达随耳机中播放的旋律同步振动，在后台反复训练手指的序列记忆。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone vibrate a four-note rhythm while students read, then test whether they can tap it back on the desk. Twist: map notes to spatial positions around the body instead of fingers.
works.exercise_zh: 让手机在学生阅读时振动出一段四音节奏，然后测试他们能否在桌上敲出来。变体：把音符映射到身体周围的空间位置，而不是手指。

works.title: Order picking with Google Glass
works.description: Warehouse workers see which bin to pick from and how many items to take on Google Glass; studies showed it was faster and caused fewer errors than paper lists or pick-by-light.
works.description_zh: 仓库工人在 Google Glass 上看到该从哪个货格取货、取多少件；研究显示它比纸质清单或亮灯拣货更快、出错更少。
works.idea_en: A glanceable head-up display beats elaborate AR when the task is repetitive and the hands are busy.
works.idea_zh: 当任务重复且双手忙碌时，一眼可读的抬头显示比复杂的 AR 更有效。
works.technique: A simple graphic of the shelf grid highlights the target bin on the HUD and advances as each pick is confirmed; an opaque display variant performed slightly better than the transparent one.
works.technique_zh: 抬头显示器上用简单的货架网格图高亮目标货格，每确认一次拣货就前进一步；不透明显示版本的表现略好于透明版本。
works.exercise_en: Build a glanceable phone overlay that guides a partner to collect five objects from labelled boxes in the right order, and time it against a paper list. Twist: remove all text and use only shapes.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个一眼可读的手机叠加界面，引导同伴按顺序从贴了标签的盒子里取出五件物品，并与纸质清单计时比较。变体：去掉所有文字，只用形状。

works.title: Digital Foam
works.description: A ball of conductive foam senses where and how hard it is squeezed, used as an input device for sculpting 3D shapes by pressing directly on a physical form.
works.description_zh: 一团导电泡沫能感知被挤压的位置和力度，被用作输入设备：直接按压实体形状来雕塑 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Sculpt digital shape by squeezing a soft physical one.
works.idea_zh: 通过挤压柔软的实体来雕塑数字形状。
works.technique: Conductive foam sensors change resistance under compression, and an array of them across the surface reports a pressure map that deforms the matching virtual mesh.
works.technique_zh: 导电泡沫传感器受压时电阻变化，布满表面的一组传感器输出压力分布图，驱动对应虚拟网格变形。
works.exercise_en: Build a squeeze controller with a phone's pressure-sensitive touch or a DIY velostat sensor, and dent a 3D sphere in WebXR where you press. Twist: make the dents spring back slowly like memory foam.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机的压感触控或自制 velostat 压力传感器做一个“挤压控制器”，在 WebXR 里按哪儿就让 3D 球体在哪儿凹陷。变体：让凹陷像记忆海绵一样慢慢回弹。

works.title: Digital Airbrushing with Spatial Augmented Reality
works.description: Holding a tracked airbrush and stencil, a designer sprays virtual paint onto a white physical object and the paint appears on it through projectors; the stencil's mask shape is virtual and can be redrawn.
works.description_zh: 设计师手持被追踪的喷枪和模板，向白色实物喷涂虚拟颜料，颜料通过投影仪显示在物体上；模板的遮罩形状是虚拟的，可以随时重画。
works.idea_en: Paint real objects with light using the familiar gestures of airbrushing.
works.idea_zh: 用熟悉的喷绘动作，以光为颜料给真实物体上色。
works.technique: Projectors are calibrated to a known object model, and tracked tool poses drive a projective-texture paint buffer that is projected back onto the object.
works.technique_zh: 投影仪根据已知的物体模型进行标定，被追踪的工具姿态驱动一个投影纹理的绘画缓冲区，再投射回物体表面。
works.exercise_en: Point a projector at a white box, track a phone as a 'spray can' and let it paint projected colour where it points. Twist: use a cardboard cut-out as a stencil that blocks paint.
works.exercise_zh: 把投影仪对准一个白盒子，用手机当“喷漆罐”被追踪，指向哪里就在哪里投射颜色。变体：用纸板剪影当模板遮挡颜料。

works.title: Improving Spatial Perception for AR X-Ray Vision
works.description: Walking outdoors with a head-worn display, users see through a building wall into the room behind it, with edges of the wall kept visible so the hidden space reads as behind rather than in front.
works.description_zh: 佩戴头戴显示器在户外行走，用户能透过建筑外墙看到墙后的房间，墙体边缘保持可见，让隐藏空间看起来确实在墙后而不是浮在前面。
works.idea_en: X-ray vision only works if you keep just enough of the occluder to show depth.
works.idea_zh: 透视只有在保留恰到好处的遮挡物时才成立，这样才能表现出深度。
works.technique: Edge detection on the video of the occluding wall is overlaid on the rendered hidden scene, providing an occlusion cue that restores correct depth ordering.
works.technique_zh: 对遮挡墙体的视频进行边缘检测，并把边缘叠加在渲染出的隐藏场景上，提供遮挡线索来恢复正确的前后关系。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, place a virtual room behind a real wall and compare three looks: plain overlay, edge-outline wall, and a cut hole. Twist: let the hole follow your gaze.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个虚拟房间放在真实墙后，比较三种效果：直接叠加、墙体边缘描线、挖一个洞。变体：让洞跟随你的视线移动。

works.title: Augmented Foam Sculpting
works.description: A designer cuts a block of foam with a tracked hot-wire cutter while projected guides show where to cut, and the system records each cut to build a matching 3D model.
works.description_zh: 设计师用被追踪的热线切割器切割泡沫块，投影指引显示该在哪里下刀，系统记录每一刀并生成对应的 3D 模型。
works.idea_en: Capture a digital model as a side effect of making a physical one.
works.idea_zh: 在制作实体模型的同时，顺便得到它的数字模型。
works.technique: The foam and cutter are tracked, each cut plane is applied as a boolean subtraction to a virtual block, and projection shows cut lines and the evolving model on the foam.
works.technique_zh: 追踪泡沫和切割器，每一刀的切割平面都作为布尔减法作用在虚拟方块上，同时把切割线和逐步成形的模型投影到泡沫上。
works.exercise_en: Carve a potato or clay block while a phone on a tripod scans after each cut and shows the growing digital copy next to it in AR. Twist: project the next suggested cut onto the block.
works.exercise_zh: 雕刻一块土豆或黏土，三脚架上的手机在每次切割后扫描，并在旁边用 AR 显示逐渐成形的数字副本。变体：把下一刀的建议线投影到块体上。

works.title: Spatial AR for Interactive Rapid Prototyping
works.description: Blank physical control panels get their buttons and dials projected onto them; users operate the projected controls just like real ones, and a study compared them with physical panels.
works.description_zh: 空白的实体控制面板上投影出按钮和旋钮，用户像操作真实控件一样操作投影控件，并通过实验与真实面板进行比较。
works.idea_en: Prototype a product's interface by projecting it onto a blank mock-up instead of manufacturing it.
works.idea_zh: 把界面投影到空白模型上来做产品原型，而不必把它制造出来。
works.technique: Calibrated projectors render controls onto the mock-up's known geometry, and finger or tool tracking detects presses on the projected widgets.
works.technique_zh: 经过标定的投影仪把控件渲染到已知几何形状的模型上，通过手指或工具追踪检测对投影控件的按压。
works.exercise_en: Project a microwave control panel onto a cardboard box, detect finger presses with a webcam and test two layouts with classmates. Twist: let the panel rearrange itself to fit the user's hand.
works.exercise_zh: 把微波炉控制面板投影到纸箱上，用网络摄像头检测手指按压，并让同学测试两种布局。变体：让面板根据用户的手自动重新排布。

works.title: Quimo
works.description: A white malleable material that designers shape with bare hands into a rough mock-up; once shaped it holds its form and becomes a projection surface for colours and details.
works.description_zh: 一种白色可塑材料，设计师徒手把它捏成粗略的模型；定形后它能保持形状，成为投影颜色和细节的表面。
works.idea_en: Quick mock-ups: sculpt by hand, then dress the rough shape with projected detail.
works.idea_zh: 快速模型：先用手捏出形状，再用投影为粗糙的形体“穿上”细节。
works.technique: Quimo is a white, shape-retaining foam material with embedded tracking markers so projectors can register imagery onto its freeform surface.
works.technique_zh: Quimo 是一种白色、能保持形状的泡沫材料，嵌有追踪标记，投影仪可以把图像准确投射到其自由曲面上。
works.exercise_en: Mould white clay into a toy shape, scan it with a LiDAR phone and project or AR-paint a texture onto it. Twist: re-mould it and see what breaks.
works.exercise_zh: 用白色黏土捏一个玩具形状，用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描，再把纹理投影或以 AR 方式绘制上去。变体：重新捏一次，看看哪里对不上了。

works.title: Improving Procedural Task Performance with AR Annotations
works.description: Participants press sequences of buttons on control panels while instructions are either shown on a monitor or projected directly onto the buttons to press next.
works.description_zh: 参与者在控制面板上按顺序按下按钮，操作指示要么显示在显示器上，要么直接投影在下一步要按的按钮上。
works.idea_en: Put the instruction exactly where the hand needs to go.
works.idea_zh: 把指示放在手正要去的地方。
works.technique: Projector-camera calibration places highlights and arrows on the physical panel, and the next step appears as each press is registered.
works.technique_zh: 通过投影仪-相机标定把高亮和箭头投射到实体面板上，每次按压被识别后显示下一步。
works.exercise_en: Project step-by-step highlights onto a board game or a set of light switches and time a partner doing a ten-step sequence against a printed manual. Twist: remove the highlight halfway and see who remembers.
works.exercise_zh: 把分步高亮投影到一个桌游或一组开关上，让同伴完成十步操作，并与纸质说明书计时比较。变体：做到一半撤掉高亮，看谁还能记得。

works.title: Embodied Axes
works.description: Three physical, motorised sliders arranged as x, y and z axes let users select ranges in a 3D data visualisation that floats above them in an AR headset.
works.description_zh: 三根带电机的实体滑轨组成 x、y、z 坐标轴，用户用它们在 AR 头显中悬浮于其上的 3D 数据可视化里选择数据范围。
works.idea_en: Turn the axes of a 3D chart into physical objects you can grab.
works.idea_zh: 把 3D 图表的坐标轴变成可以抓在手里的实体。
works.technique: The tangible controller is registered to a HoloLens scene, and actuated sliders both read the user's input and move to reflect selections made elsewhere.
works.technique_zh: 这个实体控制器与 HoloLens 场景对齐，带驱动的滑块既读取用户输入，也会移动以反映其他地方做出的选择。
works.exercise_en: Mark three rulers on a table as axes, track them with image markers and show a 3D scatter plot above them in phone AR; use a clothespin on each ruler to filter. Twist: let two people filter at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上把三把尺子当作坐标轴，用图像标记追踪，并在手机 AR 中于其上方显示 3D 散点图；在每把尺子上夹一个夹子来筛选数据。变体：让两个人同时筛选。

works.title: HoloFire (57fire)
works.description: A thermal camera watches a touch pad; the warmer your touch, the higher a fire burns inside a Pepper's-ghost holographic display.
works.description_zh: 热像仪对准一块触摸板：你的触摸越温暖，佩珀尔幻象全息展示柜里的火焰就烧得越高。
works.idea_en: Power a virtual fire with the real heat of your hand.
works.idea_zh: 用手真实的热量点燃一团虚拟火焰。
works.technique: A thermal camera measures the heat footprint left on a surface and maps its intensity to the height of a flame animation reflected in a Pepper's-ghost pyramid.
works.technique_zh: 热像仪测量手在表面留下的热量印记，把强度映射为火焰动画的高度，并通过佩珀尔幻象金字塔反射显示。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone Pepper's-ghost pyramid from clear plastic and drive a flame animation from microphone loudness (blowing on it). Twist: blowing harder should put the fire out.
works.exercise_zh: 用透明塑料做一个手机佩珀尔幻象金字塔，用麦克风音量（对着它吹气）驱动火焰动画。变体：吹得更用力时火应该被吹灭。

works.title: Geollery
works.description: A web-based mirrored world that rebuilds city streets from street-view and map data and fills them with geotagged social media posts that people can walk up to and chat around as avatars.
works.description_zh: 一个网页上的“镜像世界”：用街景和地图数据重建城市街道，并在其中放置带地理标签的社交媒体内容，人们以虚拟化身走过去围在一起聊天。
works.idea_en: Social media placed back where it happened, in a walkable 3D copy of the city.
works.idea_zh: 把社交媒体内容放回它发生的地方，放进一座可以行走的 3D 城市副本。
works.technique: A progressive pipeline extrudes buildings from OpenStreetMap footprints, textures them with street-view panoramas and streams geotagged posts as billboards, all rendered with WebGL.
works.technique_zh: 渐进式管线根据 OpenStreetMap 的建筑轮廓挤出楼体，贴上街景全景纹理，再把带地理标签的帖子作为广告牌流式加载，全部用 WebGL 渲染。
works.exercise_en: Collect ten geotagged photos from your campus and place them as floating cards at their real locations in a location-based AR app. Twist: let each card fade the longer ago it was taken.
works.exercise_zh: 收集校园里十张带地理标签的照片，用基于位置的 AR 应用把它们作为悬浮卡片放在真实位置。变体：照片拍得越久远，卡片就越透明。

works.title: DepthLab
works.description: A library of dozens of phone-AR interactions built only from a depth map: virtual objects hide behind real furniture, splat paint on walls, cast shadows, bounce on the floor and get lit by virtual lights.
works.description_zh: 一个包含数十种手机 AR 交互的库，全部只依赖深度图：虚拟物体会躲到真实家具后面，把颜料溅到墙上，投下阴影，在地板上弹跳，并被虚拟灯光照亮。
works.idea_en: Once a phone knows depth, occlusion, physics and relighting become cheap building blocks for play.
works.idea_zh: 只要手机知道深度，遮挡、物理和重新打光就成了便宜好用的游戏积木。
works.technique: Monocular depth from the ARCore Depth API is used per pixel for occlusion, converted to a mesh for collisions and to surface normals for lighting and splats.
works.technique_zh: 利用 ARCore Depth API 提供的单目深度，逐像素处理遮挡，转换成网格用于碰撞，再计算表面法线用于光照和溅射效果。
works.exercise_en: Use AR occlusion and mesh collisions to make a ball that rolls under your real table and hides behind the chair. Twist: let the ball leave a paint trail on every real surface it touches.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 遮挡和网格碰撞做一个会滚到真实桌子底下、躲到椅子后面的球。变体：让球在它碰到的每个真实表面上留下颜料痕迹。

works.title: Visual Captions
works.description: During a video call or in-person chat, the system listens to the conversation and suggests images, maps or emoji that illustrate what is being said, which speakers can show with one click.
works.description_zh: 在视频通话或面对面交谈中，系统聆听对话内容，推荐能说明所讲内容的图片、地图或表情，说话者一键即可展示。
works.idea_en: Live visuals that follow the conversation, like captions but in pictures.
works.idea_zh: 随对话实时出现的画面，就像字幕，只不过是图片。
works.technique: A fine-tuned large language model predicts from the last spoken sentence what visual would help and what kind, and image search fills it in with the user choosing how proactive it is.
works.technique_zh: 微调过的大语言模型根据最近一句话预测需要什么样的视觉内容，再用图像检索补全，用户可以选择系统有多主动。
works.exercise_en: Build a web page that transcribes speech and, for every noun it hears, shows a matching emoji floating next to the speaker in a phone AR view. Twist: only show images when two people say the same word.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个网页：转写语音，每听到一个名词，就在手机 AR 画面中说话人旁边浮现一个对应的表情。变体：只有两个人都说到同一个词时才显示图片。

works.title: Sensible Agent
works.description: A proactive AR assistant that decides not only what help to offer but how, choosing between a glanceable icon, audio or a question you answer with a nod or a gaze, depending on whether your hands are busy or you are in a conversation.
works.description_zh: 一个主动式 AR 助手，不仅决定提供什么帮助，还决定如何提供：根据你是否双手忙碌或正在交谈，在一眼可读的图标、语音，或用点头、注视即可回答的提问之间选择。
works.idea_en: A good assistant reads the social situation before it speaks.
works.idea_zh: 好的助手在开口之前会先读懂社交场合。
works.technique: A multimodal model reads egocentric video and audio to infer context, then a policy selects both the assistance and the least disruptive input and output modality, such as head gestures or gaze dwell.
works.technique_zh: 多模态模型读取第一人称视频和音频来推断情境，再由策略同时选择帮助内容和干扰最小的输入输出方式，比如头部手势或注视停留。
works.exercise_en: Design three delivery modes (icon, whisper, nod question) for one AR reminder, and act out when each is appropriate in class. Twist: the assistant must stay silent if two people are talking.
works.exercise_zh: 为同一条 AR 提醒设计三种呈现方式（图标、耳语、点头提问），并在课堂上表演出每种方式适合的场景。变体：如果有两个人在说话，助手必须保持沉默。

works.title: XR Blocks and Vibe Coding XR
works.description: An open-source WebXR framework that packages hands, depth, physics and AI agents into high-level blocks, so that a single text prompt to Gemini can generate a working interactive XR prototype.
works.description_zh: 一个开源 WebXR 框架，把手势、深度、物理和 AI 智能体封装成高层积木，于是只需给 Gemini 一句文字提示，就能生成一个可交互的 XR 原型。
works.idea_en: Make XR prototyping as quick as describing the idea in a sentence.
works.idea_zh: 让 XR 原型制作像用一句话描述想法一样快。
works.technique: The framework abstracts sensor input and scene understanding into a small script API, which an LLM can target reliably when it writes the app code.
works.technique_zh: 框架把传感器输入和场景理解抽象成简洁的脚本 API，大语言模型写应用代码时可以稳定地调用它。
works.exercise_en: In pairs, write a one-sentence XR idea, have an LLM generate a WebXR scene from it and iterate three times in class. Twist: swap prompts with another pair and remix.
works.exercise_zh: 两人一组写一句话的 XR 创意，让大语言模型生成 WebXR 场景，并在课堂上迭代三次。变体：与另一组交换提示词再混编。

works.title: AgentHands
works.description: An AI agent in XR gets a pair of virtual hands that point at, trace and hold up real and virtual objects while it talks, so its explanations are grounded in the space around you.
works.description_zh: XR 中的 AI 智能体拥有一双虚拟手，说话时会指向、描画并举起真实和虚拟的物体，让它的解释扎根于你周围的空间。
works.idea_en: Give a talking AI hands, so it can point instead of describe.
works.idea_zh: 给会说话的 AI 一双手，让它可以指给你看，而不是描述给你听。
works.technique: An LLM plans speech together with gesture tokens that reference scene objects, and a motion generator turns them into hand animations aligned to object positions.
works.technique_zh: 大语言模型同时规划语音和指向场景物体的手势标记，再由动作生成器把它们变成与物体位置对齐的手部动画。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, add a floating virtual hand to a chatbot that points to a named object in the room when you ask 'where is my ...?'. Twist: let the hand act out the size of an object.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中为聊天机器人加一只悬浮的虚拟手，当你问“我的……在哪里？”时，它会指向房间里的对应物体。变体：让这只手比划出物体的大小。

works.title: LUMAR: hybrid 2D/3D mobile AR
works.description: Pointing a phone at a printed apartment floor plan pops up a 3D model of the apartment on the phone, while the paper remains the overview: three layers of information from one printout.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一张打印的户型图，手机上就会弹出公寓的 3D 模型，而纸张本身仍是总览图：一张打印稿提供三层信息。
works.idea_en: Let paper and phone work together: the static print gives context, the phone adds depth.
works.idea_zh: 让纸和手机协作：静态打印提供整体语境，手机补充深度。
works.technique: 2D tracking of the phone over the display surface is combined with 3D marker-based pose estimation, switching the phone view between an overlay and a 3D viewport.
works.technique_zh: 把手机在显示表面上的 2D 追踪与基于标记的 3D 姿态估计结合起来，让手机画面在叠加层和 3D 视窗之间切换。
works.exercise_en: Print a campus map and use image tracking so each building pops up in 3D when the phone hovers over it. Twist: tilting the phone flattens the model back into the map.
works.exercise_zh: 打印一张校园地图，用图像追踪让手机悬停在某栋楼上时它以 3D 形式弹出。变体：倾斜手机时模型重新压扁回地图里。

works.title: LightSense: mixed-reality phone over a display
works.description: Holding a phone over a backlit Stockholm subway map shows context-sensitive information for the spot under it, turning the map into a lookup surface.
works.description_zh: 把手机放在背光的斯德哥尔摩地铁图上方，手机就会显示下方位置的相关信息，让地图变成一个可查询的表面。
works.idea_en: The phone's own light becomes its tracking system, so the map needs no markers.
works.idea_zh: 手机自身的光就是它的追踪系统，地图不需要任何标记。
works.technique: The phone's LED is tracked by a camera behind the translucent map, giving its position so the phone can show the matching content.
works.technique_zh: 半透明地图后面的摄像头追踪手机的 LED，得出手机位置，再让手机显示相应的内容。
works.exercise_en: Put a webcam under a glass table with a paper map on it and track a phone flashlight from below to trigger content on the phone. Twist: use two phones and show the route between them.
works.exercise_zh: 在玻璃桌下放一个网络摄像头，桌面放一张纸质地图，从下方追踪手机闪光灯的位置来触发手机上的内容。变体：用两部手机，并显示它们之间的路线。

works.title: ASTOR: spatial AR on an industrial lathe
works.description: A transparent holographic window mounted in front of a CNC lathe shows 3D overlays, such as forces on the cutting tool, directly on the machining process, without glasses.
works.description_zh: 安装在数控车床前的透明全息窗口，直接在加工过程上显示 3D 叠加信息（例如切削刀具受到的力），无需佩戴眼镜。
works.idea_en: Turn the machine's safety window into an autostereoscopic AR display.
works.idea_zh: 把机器的安全观察窗变成裸眼立体 AR 显示屏。
works.technique: A holographic optical element redirects projected images to each eye from a transparent screen, creating an optical see-through, glasses-free 3D overlay registered to the machine.
works.technique_zh: 全息光学元件把投影图像从透明屏幕分别导向双眼，形成与机器对齐的光学透视、免眼镜的 3D 叠加。
works.exercise_en: Mount a sheet of acrylic in front of a desk object at 45° and reflect a phone screen onto it to overlay live labels (Pepper's ghost). Twist: make a label follow a moving part.
works.exercise_zh: 在桌上物体前以 45° 放一块亚克力板，把手机屏幕反射到上面叠加实时标签（佩珀尔幻象）。变体：让标签跟随一个运动的部件。

works.title: SurfaceFusion
works.description: Physical objects placed on a Microsoft Surface table are identified by RFID and located by computer vision, so virtual content follows and responds to real things on the tabletop.
works.description_zh: 放在 Microsoft Surface 桌面上的实物通过 RFID 识别身份、通过计算机视觉确定位置，于是虚拟内容会跟随并回应桌上的真实物品。
works.idea_en: Combine two weak sensors to make ordinary objects first-class citizens of a touch table.
works.idea_zh: 把两种各有短板的传感器结合起来，让普通物品成为触控桌上的“一等公民”。
works.technique: Vision on the table's IR camera gives object position and RFID gives identity; fusing them removes the need for printed tags on every object.
works.technique_zh: 桌子的红外摄像头视觉提供物体位置，RFID 提供身份，融合两者后，物体上就不必贴印刷标签。
works.exercise_en: Use a webcam over a table to track coloured objects and an NFC phone tap to name each one, then project labels that follow them. Twist: make objects react when they are placed near each other.
works.exercise_zh: 用桌子上方的网络摄像头追踪彩色物体，用手机 NFC 轻触为每个物体命名，然后投影出跟随它们的标签。变体：当物体彼此靠近时让它们产生反应。

works.title: Wearable Subtitles
works.description: Lightweight eyewear shows live captions of the conversation in front of the wearer, letting deaf and hard-of-hearing people keep their eyes on the speaker instead of a phone.
works.description_zh: 轻便的眼镜在佩戴者眼前实时显示对话字幕，让聋人和听障人士可以看着说话人，而不必低头看手机。
works.idea_en: Captions belong in the line of sight, not in your hand.
works.idea_zh: 字幕应该在视线里，而不是在手里。
works.technique: A low-power head-worn display is paired with a phone running speech recognition, with a hybrid design that keeps glasses light and battery life near all-day.
works.technique_zh: 低功耗头戴显示器与运行语音识别的手机配合，这种混合设计让眼镜保持轻便，续航接近一整天。
works.exercise_en: Make a phone-in-headset (cardboard or HoloKit) captioning view that shows live speech-to-text above the speaker's head. Twist: shrink text when the speaker is far away.
works.exercise_zh: 用纸盒或 HoloKit 头显加手机，做一个把实时语音转文字显示在说话人头顶的字幕视图。变体：说话人离得远时字体变小。

works.title: SpeechCompass
works.description: A phone case with several microphones localises who is speaking in a group and shows each caption with an arrow or colour pointing toward that speaker.
works.description_zh: 带多个麦克风的手机壳可以定位群聊中是谁在说话，并在每条字幕旁用箭头或颜色指向对应的说话人。
works.idea_en: Captions that know where each voice comes from.
works.idea_zh: 知道每个声音来自哪里的字幕。
works.technique: Real-time multi-microphone sound localisation on a small microcontroller estimates direction of arrival, which is attached to each speech-to-text segment.
works.technique_zh: 小型微控制器上运行实时多麦克风声源定位，估计声音到达方向，并把方向附加到每一段语音转文字结果上。
works.exercise_en: Use two phones' microphones on a table to guess which side a voice comes from and colour the captions left or right. Twist: show the captions as speech bubbles in AR above each person.
works.exercise_zh: 把两部手机放在桌上，用麦克风判断声音来自哪一侧，并把字幕染成左侧或右侧的颜色。变体：在 AR 中把字幕显示为每个人头顶的对话气泡。

works.title: Mise-Unseen
works.description: In VR, objects are rearranged right inside the user's field of view without them noticing, because changes are applied only where eye tracking shows they are not looking or not paying attention.
works.description_zh: 在 VR 中，物体就在用户的视野里被重新摆放而不被察觉，因为只有当眼动追踪显示用户没在看或没注意时，改变才会发生。
works.idea_en: Change the world in plain sight by timing edits to the gaps in attention.
works.idea_zh: 抓住注意力的空隙，在众目睽睽之下改变世界。
works.technique: Gaze tracking builds models of attention, intention and spatial memory, and the system schedules scene changes in the periphery or during low-attention moments.
works.technique_zh: 通过眼动追踪建立注意力、意图和空间记忆模型，系统把场景变化安排在视野边缘或注意力低的时刻进行。
works.exercise_en: In a phone AR scene, change the colour of one virtual object only when it is off-screen, and ask classmates whether they notice. Twist: try doing it while they are reading a label.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 场景中，只在某个虚拟物体离开屏幕时改变它的颜色，询问同学是否察觉。变体：试着在他们阅读标签时进行改变。

works.title: XR-Objects: Augmented Object Intelligence
works.description: Every real object in view gets its own small AR context menu: tap a pot of honey to ask for recipes, compare two bottles, or set a timer on a kettle, powered by object detection and a multimodal LLM.
works.description_zh: 视野中的每件真实物品都有自己的小型 AR 情境菜单：点一罐蜂蜜可以查菜谱，对比两瓶饮料，或者给水壶设置计时器，由物体检测和多模态大语言模型驱动。
works.idea_en: Treat every physical object as if it were a digital one you can click on.
works.idea_zh: 把每一件实体物品都当作可以点开的数字对象。
works.technique: Real-time object detection anchors semantic menus to each object in 3D, and a multimodal LLM answers queries using a cropped image of the selected object as context.
works.technique_zh: 实时物体检测把语义菜单锚定到三维空间中的每个物体上，多模态大语言模型以所选物体的裁剪图像为上下文回答问题。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, detect three kitchen objects and attach a 'what can I do with this?' button to each that queries an LLM. Twist: allow a question that involves two objects at once.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中识别三件厨房物品，并给每件物品加一个“我能用它做什么？”按钮，调用大语言模型回答。变体：允许同时涉及两件物品的提问。

works.title: MRTransformer
works.description: Two people in rooms with different layouts collaborate in MR as avatars; the system rewrites where each avatar looks and points so the gestures still land on the right objects in the other person's room.
works.description_zh: 两个身处不同布局房间的人以虚拟化身在 MR 中协作；系统会改写每个化身的注视和指向方向，让手势在对方房间里仍然指向正确的物体。
works.idea_en: Translate body language between mismatched spaces, not just positions.
works.idea_zh: 在不对应的空间之间翻译肢体语言，而不仅仅是位置。
works.technique: The avatar's gaze and pointing targets are retargeted semantically to the equivalent objects in the remote room, and the motion is adjusted with inverse kinematics.
works.technique_zh: 把化身的注视和指向目标按语义重新映射到远端房间中对应的物体上，再用逆运动学调整动作。
works.exercise_en: Two students in different rooms each place the same three objects in different spots; show each other's pointing as an AR arrow that snaps to the matching object locally. Twist: add a shrug gesture meaning 'not here'.
works.exercise_zh: 两名学生在不同房间里把同样的三件物品放在不同位置；把对方的指向显示为 AR 箭头，并吸附到本地对应的物体上。变体：加一个表示“不在这儿”的耸肩手势。

works.title: EmBARDiment
works.description: An embodied AI agent in XR watches which windows and text you have been looking at and uses that as context, so you can ask 'summarise this' or 'what did I just read?' without copying anything.
works.description_zh: XR 中的具身 AI 智能体会留意你一直在看的窗口和文字，并以此作为上下文，所以你无需复制任何内容就能说“总结一下这个”或“我刚才读了什么？”。
works.idea_en: Your gaze history is the prompt.
works.idea_zh: 你的注视历史就是提示词。
works.technique: Eye tracking builds an attention-weighted memory of on-screen text, which is passed to an LLM agent represented by an avatar alongside the spoken request.
works.technique_zh: 眼动追踪建立一个按注意力加权的屏幕文字记忆，与语音请求一起传给以虚拟化身呈现的大语言模型智能体。
works.exercise_en: Log which of five AR text panels a user looks at longest (use head direction as a proxy) and feed only that text to a chatbot when they ask a question. Twist: let the agent say which panel it used.
works.exercise_zh: 记录用户看得最久的是五个 AR 文字面板中的哪一个（用头部朝向代替眼动），在他们提问时只把那段文字交给聊天机器人。变体：让智能体说出它用的是哪个面板。

works.title: Beyond the Phone
works.description: While wearing an XR headset, content on your phone can lift off the screen: maps expand into 3D, photos spread around you and the phone becomes a controller, with smooth transitions between views.
works.description_zh: 戴着 XR 头显时，手机上的内容可以“浮”出屏幕：地图展开成 3D，照片散布在你周围，手机变成控制器，各视图之间平滑过渡。
works.idea_en: The phone and the headset are one interface, and content can flow between them.
works.idea_zh: 手机和头显是同一个界面，内容可以在两者之间流动。
works.technique: The phone's pose is tracked by the headset, and apps define multiple views (on-screen, above-screen, world-anchored) with animated transitions triggered by gestures or context.
works.technique_zh: 头显追踪手机的姿态，应用为内容定义多个视图（屏幕内、屏幕上方、锚定在世界中），通过手势或情境触发带动画的过渡。
works.exercise_en: With phone AR, make a photo on a tablet lift up into 3D when the phone is held above it. Twist: pour the photo back by tilting the phone.
works.exercise_zh: 用手机 AR，让平板上的一张照片在手机举到其上方时“升起”成 3D。变体：倾斜手机把照片“倒”回去。

works.title: Reality Proxy
works.description: In MR, crowded or distant real objects (books on a high shelf, buildings across a city) are pulled toward you as small abstract proxies that you can select, group and filter with your hands.
works.description_zh: 在 MR 中，拥挤或遥远的真实物体（高处书架上的书、城市另一头的建筑）被拉到你面前，变成小巧的抽象代理物，你可以用手选择、分组和筛选。
works.idea_en: Interact with a stand-in instead of the hard-to-reach real thing.
works.idea_zh: 与替身互动，而不是去够那个难以触及的真实物体。
works.technique: Scene understanding and an AI model segment objects and attach semantic attributes, which are mapped to proxies laid out near the hand while staying linked to the real objects.
works.technique_zh: 场景理解与 AI 模型分割物体并附上语义属性，映射成排布在手边的代理物，同时与真实物体保持关联。
works.exercise_en: Photograph a bookshelf, detect each book spine and show small AR cards of them on the table in front of you; selecting a card highlights the real book. Twist: sort the cards by colour.
works.exercise_zh: 给书架拍照，识别每本书的书脊，并在面前的桌上以小型 AR 卡片显示；选择一张卡片会高亮对应的真书。变体：按颜色排序卡片。

works.title: Revisiting Put-That-There
works.description: Bolt's 1980 'put that there' is rebuilt for XR with an LLM: you say 'move that over there' while looking and pointing, and windows rearrange themselves according to context.
works.description_zh: 把 Bolt 1980 年的“把那个放到那里”用大语言模型在 XR 中重新实现：你一边看、一边指，一边说“把那个移到那边”，窗口就会根据情境自动重新排布。
works.idea_en: Speech plus pointing is the oldest multimodal idea, and LLMs finally make its ambiguity solvable.
works.idea_zh: 语音加指向是最古老的多模态想法，而大语言模型终于能解决其中的歧义。
works.technique: Gaze and ray-pointing targets at the moment of each deictic word ('that', 'there') are passed with the transcript and window layout to an LLM, which outputs the layout change.
works.technique_zh: 在说出每个指示词（“那个”“那里”）的瞬间记录注视和射线指向的目标，连同转写文字和窗口布局一起交给大语言模型，由它输出布局变化。
works.exercise_en: Build a phone AR scene where saying 'that' selects the object at the screen centre and 'there' drops it where you point next. Twist: add 'those' for multiple objects.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个手机 AR 场景：说“那个”时选中屏幕中心的物体，说“那里”时把它放到你接下来指向的位置。变体：加入“那些”来选择多个物体。

works.title: World Mouse
works.description: A cursor that travels seamlessly from the desktop screen onto real surfaces and objects in the room, so you can point at a lamp or a wall with the mouse as precisely as at an icon.
works.description_zh: 一个光标可以从桌面屏幕无缝移动到房间里的真实表面和物体上，于是你能用鼠标像点图标一样精准地指向一盏灯或一面墙。
works.idea_en: Extend the humble mouse cursor into the physical world.
works.idea_zh: 把朴素的鼠标光标延伸到物理世界。
works.technique: The headset's scene mesh gives surfaces for the cursor to slide on, and mouse deltas are projected onto that mesh with depth-aware transitions off the monitor's edge.
works.technique_zh: 头显的场景网格为光标提供可以滑动的表面，鼠标位移被投射到网格上，在离开显示器边缘时进行考虑深度的过渡。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, drive a cursor with a second phone's touchpad and let it slide over detected planes in the room to select virtual stickers. Twist: the cursor leaves a visible trail on real surfaces.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中，用另一部手机当触控板驱动光标，让它在房间里检测到的平面上滑动，选择虚拟贴纸。变体：光标在真实表面上留下可见的轨迹。

works.title: Navig-AI-tion
works.description: Walking directions are given as spatial audio cues combined with an AI that describes nearby landmarks from the camera, so you navigate by sound and context rather than by staring at a map.
works.description_zh: 步行导航通过空间音频提示给出，同时 AI 根据摄像头画面描述附近的地标，于是你靠声音和情境导航，而不是盯着地图。
works.idea_en: Navigation you can hear, grounded in what is actually around you.
works.idea_zh: 可以“听”的导航，建立在你身边真实存在的事物之上。
works.technique: A vision-language model describes landmarks from the egocentric camera, and turn directions are rendered as spatialised sound sources placed in the direction to walk.
works.technique_zh: 视觉语言模型根据第一人称摄像头描述地标，转向提示被渲染成放置在前进方向上的空间化声源。
works.exercise_en: Guide a blindfolded partner across a courtyard using only a spatial-audio beacon placed in AR on the target. Twist: add one spoken landmark hint per 20 metres.
works.exercise_zh: 只用一个在 AR 中放置于目标处的空间音频信标，引导蒙着眼的同伴穿过院子。变体：每 20 米增加一句提到地标的语音提示。

works.title: FLARE: Fast Layout for AR
works.description: AR applications declare rules (a game board on a table, a screen on a wall, menus within reach) and the system automatically lays out their content to fit whatever room it runs in.
works.description_zh: AR 应用声明规则（棋盘放在桌上、屏幕挂在墙上、菜单伸手可及），系统就会自动布局内容，以适配运行时所在的任何房间。
works.idea_en: Describe AR content with constraints about the room, not coordinates, so it adapts to any space.
works.idea_zh: 用关于房间的约束而不是坐标来描述 AR 内容，使它适应任何空间。
works.technique: A Kinect scan is segmented into planes, and a declarative constraint solver places application objects on suitable surfaces in real time.
works.technique_zh: 把 Kinect 扫描结果分割成平面，再由声明式约束求解器实时把应用对象放到合适的表面上。
works.exercise_en: Write three layout rules for an AR app (e.g. 'lamp on highest surface') and implement them with AR plane detection, then test in three different rooms. Twist: add a rule that breaks ties randomly.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个 AR 应用写三条布局规则（例如“台灯放在最高的表面上”），用 AR 平面检测实现，并在三个不同房间测试。变体：加一条随机打破平局的规则。

works.title: GlassHands
works.description: A phone's front camera sees the user's hands above and around the phone reflected in their own eyeglasses, turning the space around the device into an input area.
works.description_zh: 手机前置摄像头通过用户自己眼镜上的反射，看到手机上方和周围的双手，把设备周围的空间变成输入区域。
works.idea_en: Use the user's eyeglasses as a mirror to extend the camera's view.
works.idea_zh: 把用户的眼镜当作镜子，扩展摄像头的视野。
works.technique: The front camera detects the reflection in the lenses of the user's glasses, rectifies it using the lens curvature and tracks hands in the reflected image.
works.technique_zh: 前置摄像头检测用户眼镜镜片中的反射图像，根据镜片曲率进行校正，并在反射图像中追踪双手。
works.exercise_en: Place a small mirror at an angle near a laptop webcam to see the desk, and use hand tracking on the reflection to control a slider. Twist: use a spoon as the mirror.
works.exercise_zh: 在笔记本摄像头旁斜放一面小镜子，让它看到桌面，并在反射画面上用手部追踪控制一个滑杆。变体：用勺子当镜子。

works.title: CLAW
works.description: A handheld VR controller with a motorised index-finger arm: it pushes back when you grasp a virtual object, resists when you touch a virtual surface and acts as a trigger when you shoot.
works.description_zh: 一款带电动食指臂的手持 VR 控制器：抓取虚拟物体时它会回推，触碰虚拟表面时会产生阻力，射击时又变成扳机。
works.idea_en: One controller, three haptic personalities, chosen by how you hold it.
works.idea_zh: 一个控制器，三种触觉“性格”，取决于你怎么握它。
works.technique: A servo-driven arm with a force sensor sits under the index finger, and grip sensing switches between grasp, touch and trigger modes to render force feedback.
works.technique_zh: 食指下方有一个带力传感器的舵机驱动臂，通过握持方式识别在抓取、触碰和扳机模式之间切换，输出力反馈。
works.exercise_en: Tape a servo to a phone case so a lever pushes against your finger when a virtual object in phone AR is touched. Twist: make soft objects push back gently and hard ones firmly.
works.exercise_zh: 把舵机贴在手机壳上，当手机 AR 中的虚拟物体被触碰时，让一根杠杆顶住你的手指。变体：软物体轻推，硬物体用力推。

works.title: SeeingVR
works.description: A toolkit of 14 visual and audio aids, such as magnification, edge enhancement, depth colouring and object descriptions, that can be added to any Unity VR app to make it usable for people with low vision.
works.description_zh: 一套包含 14 种视觉与听觉辅助的工具，比如放大、边缘增强、深度着色和物体描述，可加入任何 Unity VR 应用，让低视力人群也能使用。
works.idea_en: Accessibility filters for virtual worlds, applied like lenses over any app.
works.idea_zh: 为虚拟世界准备的无障碍滤镜，像镜片一样套在任何应用之上。
works.technique: Post-processing shaders and scene queries in a Unity plug-in add magnifiers, contrast and edge effects, depth-coded colour and text-to-speech labels without changing the app.
works.technique_zh: Unity 插件中的后处理着色器和场景查询加入放大镜、对比度与边缘效果、按深度着色，以及文字转语音标签，而无需改动原应用。
works.exercise_en: Add three low-vision aids (edge outline, magnifier, spoken label) to a phone AR scene and test them with blurred glasses. Twist: design an aid for AR that does not exist in the toolkit.
works.exercise_zh: 为一个手机 AR 场景加入三种低视力辅助（边缘描线、放大镜、语音标签），戴上模糊眼镜进行测试。变体：设计一种工具包里还没有的 AR 辅助。

works.title: DreamWalker
works.description: A person walks a real route of several hundred metres through city streets while wearing VR and sees a completely different virtual world, with obstacles and pedestrians safely mapped into it.
works.description_zh: 一个人戴着 VR 在城市街道中步行一段数百米的真实路线，看到的却是完全不同的虚拟世界，路上的障碍和行人都被安全地映射进这个世界。
works.idea_en: Replace the world while keeping its walkable shape.
works.idea_zh: 替换世界，但保留它可行走的形状。
works.technique: GPS, inside-out tracking and RGB-D cameras fuse to keep the user on a pre-planned route, and a virtual path is warped to match it while detected obstacles appear as virtual objects.
works.technique_zh: 融合 GPS、内向外追踪和 RGB-D 摄像头，让用户保持在预先规划的路线上；虚拟路径被扭曲以与之匹配，检测到的障碍物则以虚拟物体出现。
works.exercise_en: Walk a short corridor route with a phone in a headset showing only a virtual forest path mapped to it, with a spotter. Twist: turn each real door into a virtual gate.
works.exercise_zh: 在有人看护的情况下，戴着装有手机的头显走一段短走廊，头显里只显示映射到这条路线上的虚拟林间小路。变体：把每扇真实的门变成一道虚拟大门。

works.title: VRoamer
works.description: A VR game generates its levels on the fly as the player walks through a large, unknown real building: corridors become dungeon passages and rooms become arenas placed where there is actually space.
works.description_zh: 一款 VR 游戏会在玩家穿行于陌生的大型真实建筑时即时生成关卡：走廊变成地牢通道，房间变成竞技场，全都放在真正有空间的地方。
works.idea_en: The building you walk through is the level designer.
works.idea_zh: 你走过的那栋楼就是关卡设计师。
works.technique: Depth cameras detect walkable space ahead in real time, and pre-authored room and corridor modules are selected and fitted to it procedurally.
works.technique_zh: 深度相机实时检测前方可行走的空间，程序化地挑选预先制作的房间和走廊模块并将其适配上去。
works.exercise_en: Map a school hallway with AR planes and place a 'dungeon tile' on each free floor patch as you walk. Twist: doors you pass become level exits.
works.exercise_zh: 用 AR 平面扫描学校走廊，行走时在每块空地上放置一块“地牢地砖”。变体：你经过的门变成关卡出口。

works.title: MagicPen
works.description: A stylus that physically grows and shrinks, so its tip always rests on the virtual surface you are drawing on in VR, giving you something solid to press against while sculpting.
works.description_zh: 一支可以实际伸缩的触控笔，让笔尖始终停在你在 VR 中绘画的虚拟表面上，雕塑时手里总有可以按压的实感。
works.idea_en: Fake a surface by moving the tool, not the world.
works.idea_zh: 通过移动工具而不是移动世界，来模拟出一个表面。
works.technique: A motorised telescoping shaft adjusts the pen's length in real time based on the distance to the virtual surface, braced against a physical desk so pressure is grounded.
works.technique_zh: 电动伸缩笔杆根据与虚拟表面的距离实时调整笔的长度，并抵在实体桌面上，让按压力有真实的支撑。
works.exercise_en: Draw on a virtual sphere floating above a table in phone AR while physically pressing a pencil on the table, and compare with drawing in mid-air. Twist: map pencil pressure to line thickness.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中，一边在桌上实际按压铅笔，一边在悬浮于桌面上方的虚拟球体上画画，并与悬空绘画比较。变体：把铅笔压力映射为线条粗细。

works.title: EditorVR
works.description: On stage at the Vision VR/AR Summit, West puts on a headset and builds a Unity scene from inside VR, grabbing assets from floating panels and placing them with tracked controllers.
works.description_zh: 在 Vision VR/AR 峰会的舞台上，West 戴上头显，在 VR 内部搭建 Unity 场景：从漂浮的面板里抓取素材，用追踪手柄把它们放到场景中。
works.idea_en: Build spatial content where it will be experienced, with your hands, instead of on a flat monitor.
works.idea_zh: 在内容将被体验的空间里用双手创作，而不是在平面显示器上。
works.technique: The Unity editor's scene hierarchy, inspector and asset browser are re-exposed as 3D workspaces attached to the controllers, editing the same scene data as the desktop editor.
works.technique_zh: 把 Unity 编辑器的场景层级、属性面板和资源浏览器重新做成附着在手柄上的 3D 工作区，编辑的是与桌面编辑器相同的场景数据。
works.exercise_en: Design and paper-prototype a three-panel VR editing tool for arranging furniture, then build one panel in WebXR. Twist: every tool must be operable with one hand.
works.exercise_zh: 为摆放家具设计一个三面板的 VR 编辑工具并做纸面原型，再用 WebXR 实现其中一个面板。变体：每个工具都必须能单手操作。

works.title: Carte Blanche
works.description: A Unity Labs concept video for VR authoring aimed at non-programmers: users deal virtual cards to spawn objects, arrange a scene on a table-sized stage and give simple commands to a helper character.
works.description_zh: Unity Labs 面向非程序员的 VR 创作概念视频：用户像发牌一样“发出”虚拟卡片来生成物体，在桌面大小的舞台上布置场景，并给一个助手角色下达简单指令。
works.idea_en: Make world-building feel like a card game played on a tabletop.
works.idea_zh: 让搭建世界像在桌面上玩一场卡牌游戏。
works.technique: Likely a prototype where assets are represented as physical-feeling cards in a hand-tracked deck, with a miniature 'world in miniature' view for placement.
works.technique_zh: 很可能是一个原型：素材以手感真实的卡牌形式出现在可用手追踪的牌堆里，并通过“微缩世界”视图进行摆放。
works.exercise_en: Make a deck of printed image-marker cards; laying a card on the table in phone AR spawns its object in a miniature scene. Twist: stacking two cards combines their objects.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一副印有图像标记的卡牌；在手机 AR 中把卡牌放到桌上就会在微缩场景里生成对应物体。变体：叠放两张卡牌会把它们的物体组合在一起。

works.title: Unity MARS
works.description: An authoring tool for AR apps where content is placed by conditions (on a table at least 1 m wide, next to a face, on the floor near a wall) and tested in simulated rooms before being deployed to real ones.
works.description_zh: 一款 AR 应用创作工具：内容按条件放置（在宽度至少 1 米的桌子上、脸旁边、靠墙的地面上），部署到真实房间之前可以先在模拟房间中测试。
works.idea_en: Author AR against rules about reality rather than a single known room.
works.idea_zh: 针对“关于现实的规则”来创作 AR，而不是针对某一个已知的房间。
works.technique: Proxies with semantic and size conditions are matched at runtime against planes, images and faces reported by AR Foundation, and a simulation view replays recorded environments in the editor.
works.technique_zh: 带有语义和尺寸条件的代理物在运行时与 AR Foundation 报告的平面、图像和人脸进行匹配，模拟视图则在编辑器里回放录制的环境。
works.exercise_en: Write an AR scene whose three objects are placed only by rules (largest table, nearest wall, floor near a door) and test it in two rooms. Twist: add a fallback when no rule is satisfied.
works.exercise_zh: 写一个 AR 场景，其中三个物体只按规则放置（最大的桌子、最近的墙、门边的地面），并在两个房间里测试。变体：当所有规则都不满足时加一个后备方案。

works.title: Everyday Experiments
works.description: The launch film of IKEA and SPACE10's collection of 18 spatial-computing experiments for the home, from rooms that rearrange themselves in AR to virtual forts built from your furniture.
works.description_zh: IKEA 与 SPACE10 推出的 18 个家居空间计算实验合集的发布短片，从在 AR 中自动重新布置的房间，到用家具搭成的虚拟城堡。
works.idea_en: Ask many small 'what if' questions about everyday home life and answer each with a quick prototype.
works.idea_zh: 针对日常家居生活提出许多小小的“如果……会怎样”，并用快速原型逐一回答。
works.technique: Each studio built a short phone prototype using ARKit, LiDAR, object detection or machine learning, documented as a video and a one-page idea.
works.technique_zh: 每个工作室用 ARKit、LiDAR、物体识别或机器学习做一个简短的手机原型，并以一段视频和一页创意说明记录下来。
works.exercise_en: Run a mini 'Everyday Experiments' sprint: each team picks one household chore and prototypes a 60-second phone AR idea that makes it more playful. Twist: the idea must work without any text.
works.exercise_zh: 做一次迷你版 Everyday Experiments：每组选一件家务，用手机 AR 做一个 60 秒的创意原型，让它变得更好玩。变体：创意必须完全不用文字。

works.title: Everyday Experiments: Collaborative Futures
works.description: A film about the second round of Everyday Experiments, in which more than twenty studios tackled privacy, trust and well-being at home with AR, spatial audio and AI.
works.description_zh: 介绍 Everyday Experiments 第二轮的短片：二十多家工作室用 AR、空间音频和 AI 探讨家中的隐私、信任与身心健康。
works.idea_en: Use spatial computing to make invisible domestic issues (data, noise, mood) tangible.
works.idea_zh: 用空间计算让家中看不见的问题（数据、噪音、情绪）变得可感知。
works.technique: A curated commissioning model: each partner studio received a theme and produced a working prototype and film, published together on an open platform.
works.technique_zh: 一种策展式委托模式：每个合作工作室领到一个主题，做出可运行的原型和影片，统一发布在开放平台上。
works.exercise_en: Pick one invisible thing in your home (Wi-Fi, noise, air) and prototype a phone AR view that makes it visible for 30 seconds. Twist: make it visible only to one person in the room.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个家里看不见的东西（Wi-Fi、噪音、空气），做一个让它可见 30 秒的手机 AR 原型。变体：只让房间里的某一个人看得见。

works.title: Room Shuffle
works.description: A prototype from Everyday Experiments, built by Bakken & Bæck, that scans a room, recognises the furniture and proposes new arrangements, shuffling your real chairs and tables into alternative layouts in AR.
works.description_zh: Everyday Experiments 中由 Bakken & Bæck 制作的原型：扫描房间、识别家具并提出新的布置方案，在 AR 中把你真实的桌椅“洗牌”成不同布局。
works.idea_en: See the untapped potential of the space you already have.
works.idea_zh: 看见你已有空间中尚未发掘的潜力。
works.technique: Object detection and spatial mapping estimate furniture footprints, and a layout algorithm generates responsive arrangements rendered as virtual replicas in place.
works.technique_zh: 物体识别和空间映射估算家具的占地范围，布局算法生成自适应的摆放方案，并以虚拟复制品在原地呈现。
works.exercise_en: Scan three pieces of furniture with a LiDAR phone and let a script randomly rearrange their AR copies in the room. Twist: the layout must keep a clear path to the door.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机扫描三件家具，让脚本在房间里随机重新摆放它们的 AR 副本。变体：布局必须保留一条通往门口的通道。

works.title: Sound Bubbles
works.description: An Everyday Experiment by sound designer Yuri Suzuki: spatial audio creates zones of privacy in a shared home, bubbles of silence where one person can take a call while others keep making noise.
works.description_zh: 声音设计师 Yuri Suzuki 为 Everyday Experiments 做的实验：用空间音频在共享的家中制造隐私区域，形成一个个“静音气泡”，让一个人能打电话，而其他人照常制造噪音。
works.idea_en: Use sound to create silence.
works.idea_zh: 用声音制造安静。
works.technique: Likely directional speakers and noise masking, coordinated through IoT devices, shape the sound field around a listener's position.
works.technique_zh: 很可能通过物联网设备协调定向扬声器和噪声掩蔽，在聆听者所在位置周围塑造声场。
works.exercise_en: Place a virtual 'quiet bubble' in phone AR; when a person stands inside it, lower the volume of music playing from other phones in the room. Twist: bubbles can be passed from person to person.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放置一个虚拟“安静气泡”；当有人站进去时，降低房间里其他手机播放音乐的音量。变体：气泡可以在人与人之间传递。

works.title: Studio
works.description: SPACE10's own Everyday Experiments app: a LiDAR scan turns your room into a 3D plan you can measure, restyle with furniture, relight with virtual lamps that switch on and off, and share.
works.description_zh: SPACE10 自己为 Everyday Experiments 开发的应用：用 LiDAR 扫描把房间变成可测量的 3D 平面图，可以用家具重新布置，用能开关的虚拟灯具重新照明，并分享出去。
works.idea_en: Turn the phone into a democratic interior design tool for the room you are standing in.
works.idea_zh: 把手机变成人人可用的室内设计工具，就用在你所站的房间里。
works.technique: The iPhone LiDAR sensor captures depth to build floor plans and surface meshes, and dynamic AR light sources are rendered with photorealistic lighting on the scanned geometry.
works.technique_zh: iPhone 的 LiDAR 传感器采集深度，生成平面图和表面网格，并在扫描几何体上以写实光照渲染动态 AR 光源。
works.exercise_en: Scan your dorm room, place one virtual lamp and toggle it on and off in AR to judge where light is needed. Twist: let a classmate redesign your room remotely from the scan.
works.exercise_zh: 扫描你的宿舍，放一盏虚拟台灯，在 AR 中开关它，判断哪里需要光。变体：让同学根据扫描远程重新设计你的房间。

works.title: Spatial Instruments
works.description: Moving a phone around the living room turns every object it sees into part of an ever-changing soundscape: shelves, lamps and sofas each play notes based on their shape, depth, colour and position.
works.description_zh: 拿着手机在客厅里移动，它看到的每件物品都会成为不断变化的声景的一部分：书架、台灯和沙发根据各自的形状、深度、颜色和位置发出不同的音符。
works.idea_en: Perceive your room through sound instead of sight, so rearranging furniture becomes composing.
works.idea_zh: 用声音而不是视觉感知房间，于是重新摆放家具就变成了作曲。
works.technique: LiDAR depth and object detection segment the room into objects, and each object's size, distance and colour are mapped to pitch, timbre and rhythm in a generative audio engine.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 深度和物体识别把房间分割成一个个物体，再把每个物体的尺寸、距离和颜色映射成生成式音频引擎中的音高、音色和节奏。
works.exercise_en: Map the heights of detected AR planes in a room to notes and play them as the phone sweeps past. Twist: moving one chair must change the melody.
works.exercise_zh: 把房间里检测到的 AR 平面高度映射成音符，手机扫过时依次演奏。变体：移动一把椅子必须改变旋律。

works.title: Fort Builder
works.description: Digital copies of your real sofa cushions, chairs and lamps can be stacked into a fort that ignores gravity until you let go, and then it all comes crashing down without breaking anything.
works.description_zh: 把你真实的沙发垫、椅子和台灯的数字副本堆成一座无视重力的城堡，直到你松手，它才轰然倒塌，而不会弄坏任何东西。
works.idea_en: The childhood joy of building and smashing a fort, without the mess.
works.idea_zh: 重温童年搭城堡、再推倒它的快乐，却不会弄得一团糟。
works.technique: Objects are captured from the room as meshes, stacked with physics suspended, then released into a rigid-body simulation that collides with the scanned room.
works.technique_zh: 从房间中把物体捕捉为网格，在暂停物理的情况下堆叠，然后释放到与扫描房间发生碰撞的刚体模拟中。
works.exercise_en: Stack AR copies of three scanned objects into a tower in phone AR, then tap to enable gravity. Twist: the tallest tower in class wins, but it must stand for five seconds.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把三个扫描物体的 AR 副本叠成一座塔，然后点击开启重力。变体：全班最高的塔获胜，但必须屹立五秒。

works.title: Extreme Measures
works.description: Instead of a tape measure, you place a virtual elephant under the bed or in a nook and it inflates until it fills the space, giving an intuitive sense of how much room is there.
works.description_zh: 不用卷尺，而是把一头虚拟大象放到床底或角落里，它会膨胀直到填满空间，让你直观感受那里到底有多大。
works.idea_en: Measure space by filling it with something absurd and friendly.
works.idea_zh: 用荒诞又友好的东西填满空间，以此来测量它。
works.technique: LiDAR depth defines the free volume around a placed anchor, and a character mesh scales until it collides with the surrounding geometry, reporting the resulting size.
works.technique_zh: LiDAR 深度确定放置锚点周围的空闲体积，角色网格不断缩放直到与周围几何体碰撞，并报告最终尺寸。
works.exercise_en: In phone AR, place a balloon in a shelf gap and grow it until it hits the planes around it, then show its volume in 'balloons'. Twist: choose a unit that makes people laugh.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中把一个气球放进书架空隙，让它不断变大直到碰到周围的平面，然后以“几个气球”为单位显示体积。变体：选一个能让人发笑的单位。

works.title: Digital Buddy
works.description: A small 3D avatar appears next to you in AR and explains long terms and conditions in plain language, for example answering whether a messaging app can read your private messages.
works.description_zh: 一个小小的 3D 化身在 AR 中出现在你身边，用通俗的话解释冗长的用户条款，比如回答某个聊天应用能不能读你的私信。
works.idea_en: A companion on your side that reads the fine print for you.
works.idea_zh: 一个站在你这边、替你读小字条款的伙伴。
works.technique: GPT-3 summarises and answers questions about privacy policies, and the answer is voiced by an animated AR character placed on a nearby surface.
works.technique_zh: 用 GPT-3 总结隐私政策并回答相关问题，答案由放在附近表面上的 AR 动画角色说出来。
works.exercise_en: Place a character in phone AR that reads a pasted app policy through an LLM and answers three yes/no questions. Twist: the character's mood changes with how privacy-friendly the answer is.
works.exercise_zh: 在手机 AR 中放置一个角色，它通过大语言模型读取粘贴进来的应用条款，并回答三个是否题。变体：角色的情绪随答案的隐私友好程度变化。

works.title: Chain of Traceability
works.description: Point a phone at a household object and AR reveals its history: where its materials came from, how it was made, its carbon footprint and how it could be repurposed.
works.description_zh: 把手机对准一件家居物品，AR 就会展示它的来历：材料来自哪里、如何制造、碳足迹多少，以及未来可以怎样再利用。
works.idea_en: Let objects tell their own life story, from source to second life.
works.idea_zh: 让物品讲述自己的一生，从原料到“第二次生命”。
works.technique: Neural-network object recognition identifies the item, looks up a digital twin registered on a blockchain and renders its supply-chain data as AR layers around it.
works.technique_zh: 神经网络识别物品，查找登记在区块链上的数字孪生，并把供应链数据渲染成物品周围的 AR 图层。
works.exercise_en: Pick three objects in class, research where they came from and attach an AR timeline that unfolds from each when recognised. Twist: end each timeline with an idea for its next life.
works.exercise_zh: 在课堂上挑三件物品，调查它们的来源，并在识别时从每件物品上展开一条 AR 时间线。变体：每条时间线都以它“下一段生命”的创意结尾。

works.title: CLOUDS
works.description: An interactive generative documentary about code and culture: dozens of creative coders filmed as flickering depth-camera point clouds, surrounded by live visual systems, with a story engine choosing what comes next.
works.description_zh: 一部关于代码与文化的交互式生成纪录片：几十位创意编程者被拍成闪烁的深度点云，周围环绕着实时运行的视觉系统，由“故事引擎”决定接下来播放什么。
works.idea_en: Film people as data, so the documentary itself can be rearranged and explored like code.
works.idea_zh: 把人拍成数据，让纪录片本身也能像代码一样被重组和探索。
works.technique: Interviews were shot with RGBD (a Kinect mounted on a DSLR, calibrated with the open-source RGBDToolkit), and an openFrameworks story engine sequences clips and generative scenes.
works.technique_zh: 访谈用 RGBD 方式拍摄（Kinect 装在单反相机上，用开源的 RGBDToolkit 标定），openFrameworks 编写的故事引擎负责编排片段和生成式场景。
