works.exercise_en: Record a classmate's 30-second answer with a LiDAR phone as a point cloud and place it in AR next to the question written in 3D. Twist: dissolve the point cloud when the answer ends.
works.exercise_zh: 用带 LiDAR 的手机把同学 30 秒的回答录成点云，在 AR 中把它放在以 3D 文字写出的问题旁边。变体：回答结束时让点云消散。

works.title: Zero Days VR
works.description: A VR documentary about the Stuxnet cyberweapon that places you inside the invisible world of computer code, travelling through data centres and centrifuges at human scale.
works.description_zh: 一部关于 Stuxnet 网络武器的 VR 纪录片，把你带进看不见的计算机代码世界，以人的尺度穿行于数据中心和离心机之间。
works.idea_en: Give an invisible event a body and a space you can stand in.
works.idea_zh: 给一个看不见的事件一个身体、一个你可以站进去的空间。
works.technique: Volumetric interviews captured with Depthkit are combined with abstract data visualisation in Unity to create a navigable space.
works.technique_zh: 用 Depthkit 捕捉的体积影像访谈与 Unity 中的抽象数据可视化结合，构成可以游历的空间。
works.exercise_en: Pick an invisible process (a text message being sent, Wi-Fi) and stage it in room-scale AR around the class as a journey. Twist: let the audience be the data packet.
works.exercise_zh: 选一个看不见的过程（一条短信被发送、Wi-Fi 信号），在教室里用房间尺度的 AR 把它演绎成一段旅程。变体：让观众自己成为数据包。

works.title: The Changing Same
works.description: An episodic VR experience in which the participant travels through non-linear time and space to witness connected moments of racial injustice in the United States.
works.description_zh: 一部分集 VR 体验：参与者在非线性的时间与空间中穿行，见证美国种族不公的一系列相互关联的历史时刻。
works.idea_en: Time travel through one place to show that history repeats in cycles.
works.idea_zh: 在同一个地点穿越时间，展示历史如何循环往复。
works.technique: Volumetric performances captured with Depthkit are staged in Unity environments that transform between eras around the participant.
works.technique_zh: 用 Depthkit 捕捉的体积表演被安排在 Unity 环境中，环境围绕参与者在不同时代之间变换。
works.exercise_en: Choose one spot on campus and build a phone AR piece that shows three photos from different decades at the exact same viewpoint. Twist: make the transition happen when the viewer steps forward.
works.exercise_zh: 选校园里的一个地点，做一个手机 AR 作品，在完全相同的视角展示三个不同年代的照片。变体：让观众向前迈一步时触发切换。

works.title: Depthkit Holoportation via webcam
works.description: A full-body volumetric person is captured with depth cameras and livestreamed as a hologram into AR and VR scenes for teleconferencing and performance.
works.description_zh: 用深度相机捕捉的全身体积影像人物，以全息形式实时直播进 AR 和 VR 场景，用于远程会议和表演。
works.idea_en: Stream a person, not a video rectangle.
works.idea_zh: 直播的是一个人，而不是一块视频方框。
works.technique: Depthkit Studio fuses several depth sensors into a textured mesh sequence, compresses it as video and streams it to a Unity or web client that reconstructs the hologram.
works.technique_zh: Depthkit Studio 把多个深度传感器的数据融合成带纹理的网格序列，压缩为视频流，发送到 Unity 或网页客户端重建全息影像。
works.exercise_en: Record a 10-second LiDAR point-cloud clip of a classmate and play it back life-size in phone AR in the hallway. Twist: make the hologram only visible from one side.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 录一段同学 10 秒的点云片段，并在走廊里以真人大小在手机 AR 中回放。变体：让全息影像只能从一侧看到。

works.title: The MetaBox
works.description: Participants step into an Igloo immersive projection room and instantly appear as volumetric holograms to remote colleagues in VR, so body language crosses between the two spaces.
works.description_zh: 参与者走进 Igloo 沉浸式投影房间，就会立刻以体积全息影像出现在远程 VR 同事面前，让肢体语言在两个空间之间传递。
works.idea_en: A room that turns whoever walks in into a hologram for someone far away.
works.idea_zh: 一个把走进来的人变成远方全息影像的房间。
works.technique: Depthkit volumetric capture inside the projection room streams participants into a shared VR scene, while the remote VR view is projected on the room's walls.
works.technique_zh: 投影房间内的 Depthkit 体积捕捉把参与者实时传入共享 VR 场景，同时远端 VR 画面被投影到房间的墙上。
works.exercise_en: Set up a corner with a projector showing a remote classmate's video on the wall while your phone streams you to them. Twist: only show the remote person when both of you face the wall.
works.exercise_zh: 布置一个角落：投影仪在墙上显示远程同学的视频，同时用手机把你传给对方。变体：只有你们都面对墙时才显示对方。

works.title: Project Tango
works.description: Google ATAP introduces a phone prototype with depth sensors and motion tracking that maps rooms in 3D as you walk, hinting at indoor navigation, AR games and measuring spaces.
works.description_zh: Google ATAP 发布一款装有深度传感器和运动追踪的手机原型：你边走，它边以 3D 方式绘制房间，预示室内导航、AR 游戏和空间测量等可能。
works.idea_en: Give a phone a human-scale understanding of space and motion.
works.idea_zh: 赋予手机对空间和运动的人类尺度理解。
works.technique: A fisheye camera, a depth sensor and an IMU feed visual-inertial odometry and area learning that produce a live 6DoF pose and a 3D point cloud of the surroundings.
works.technique_zh: 鱼眼相机、深度传感器和惯性测量单元共同驱动视觉惯性里程计和区域学习，实时输出 6DoF 姿态和周围环境的 3D 点云。
works.exercise_en: Walk a hallway with an AR app that drops a breadcrumb every metre, then ask a partner to follow the crumbs back. Twist: hide one crumb that only appears when you crouch.
works.exercise_zh: 拿着 AR 应用走一段走廊，每走一米放一个“面包屑”，再让同伴沿着面包屑走回来。变体：藏一个只有蹲下才能看到的面包屑。

works.title: Project Tango: NASA SPHERES
works.description: A Tango phone is mounted on SPHERES, NASA's floating robots inside the International Space Station, giving them the ability to see and map the module to navigate on their own.
works.description_zh: 一部 Tango 手机被装在 NASA 的 SPHERES 漂浮机器人上，在国际空间站舱内帮助它们看见并绘制舱室地图，从而自主导航。
works.idea_en: The same spatial-awareness chip that plays AR games can guide a robot in zero gravity.
works.idea_zh: 能玩 AR 游戏的空间感知芯片，也能在失重环境里为机器人导航。
works.technique: Tango's visual-inertial tracking and depth mapping replace external beacons, feeding pose estimates to the free-flying robot's control system.
works.technique_zh: Tango 的视觉惯性追踪和深度建图取代了外部信标，把姿态估计提供给自由飞行机器人的控制系统。
works.exercise_en: Mount a phone on a toy car or robot and use AR world tracking to make it return to a marked start point. Twist: let a second phone see the robot's path as an AR trail.
works.exercise_zh: 把手机装在玩具车或机器人上，用 AR 世界追踪让它回到标记的起点。变体：让另一部手机以 AR 轨迹看到机器人的路径。

works.title: Spotlight Stories
works.description: Animated short films made for the phone: you hold the phone up like a window and turn around to follow the story unfolding all around you, and the story waits for you to look.
works.description_zh: 为手机打造的动画短片：你把手机举起来当作一扇窗，转身跟随在你四周展开的故事，而故事会等你看过去再继续。
works.idea_en: Let the viewer hold the camera, and let the story wait for their attention.
works.idea_zh: 让观众掌控镜头，让故事等待观众的注意力。
works.technique: Phone orientation sensors drive the virtual camera in a real-time rendered 360° scene, with story beats triggered when the viewer looks at the right place.
works.technique_zh: 手机的方向传感器驱动实时渲染的 360° 场景中的虚拟相机，当观众看向正确位置时触发故事节点。
works.exercise_en: Make a 360° phone scene with three story beats placed around the viewer, each triggered only when they look at it. Twist: the story's ending depends on which beat they saw last.
works.exercise_zh: 制作一个 360° 手机场景，在观众周围放三个故事节点，只有看向它时才触发。变体：故事结局取决于观众最后看到的是哪个节点。

works.title: Nonverbal Interactions with Soli Radar
works.description: Devices use radar to read body language: a screen wakes as you approach, pauses a video when you turn away, and responds to leaning in or glancing, without cameras.
works.description_zh: 设备用雷达读懂肢体语言：你走近时屏幕亮起，你转身离开时视频暂停，还能回应你的前倾或瞥视，全程不需要摄像头。
works.idea_en: Devices that respond to social cues like approach and turning away, the way people do.
works.idea_zh: 设备像人一样回应“走近”“转身”这类社交信号。
works.technique: Soli millimetre-wave radar senses distance, orientation and motion of the body, and machine learning classifies movements such as approach, pass, turn and glance.
works.technique_zh: Soli 毫米波雷达感知身体的距离、朝向和运动，机器学习把这些动作分类为走近、路过、转身和瞥视等。
works.exercise_en: Use a laptop webcam's face detection to pause a video when you look away and resume when you turn back. Twist: make it respond differently to two people.
works.exercise_zh: 用笔记本摄像头的人脸检测，在你移开视线时暂停视频，转回来时继续播放。变体：让它对两个人作出不同的反应。

works.title: Terminal 3
works.description: In HoloLens, you play a US airport border officer interrogating life-size volumetric Muslim travellers; as their stories emerge, their bodies fill in from wireframe to full hologram, and you decide whether to let them in.
works.description_zh: 在 HoloLens 中，你扮演美国机场的边境官，审问真人大小的穆斯林旅客体积影像；随着他们的故事展开，他们的身体从线框逐渐变成完整的全息影像，最后由你决定是否放行。
works.idea_en: Make the viewer hold power over a stranger in their own space, and let empathy literally fill in the person.
works.idea_zh: 让观众在自己的空间里掌握对陌生人的权力，并让同理心真的把这个人“填满”。
works.technique: Interviews captured volumetrically with Depthkit are played back in HoloLens, and the visual resolution of each traveller increases with the dialogue choices made.
works.technique_zh: 用 Depthkit 体积捕捉的访谈在 HoloLens 中回放，每位旅客的视觉清晰度随玩家所做的对话选择而提升。
works.exercise_en: Record a classmate's short story as a LiDAR point cloud and reveal it in phone AR only as the listener asks more questions. Twist: the listener must decide something at the end.
works.exercise_zh: 用 LiDAR 把一位同学讲的小故事录成点云，在手机 AR 中只有当听者问出更多问题时才逐渐显现。变体：听者最后必须作出一个决定。

works.title: A Jester's Tale
works.description: A Magic Leap narrative that premiered at Sundance: you come home cold and tired for a bedtime story, and a psychologically unsettling children's fable spills into the physical room around you.
works.description_zh: 在圣丹斯首映的 Magic Leap 叙事作品：你又冷又累地回到家听一个睡前故事，一则令人心理不安的童话渐渐溢出到你身边的真实房间。
works.idea_en: Let a fairy tale invade your room until you are inside it.
works.idea_zh: 让童话一点点侵入你的房间，直到你身处其中。
works.technique: Magic Leap spatial mapping anchors volumetric and animated characters to the room's furniture, with interactions that respond to the viewer's position.
works.technique_zh: Magic Leap 的空间映射把体积影像和动画角色锚定在房间家具上，交互会根据观众的位置作出反应。
works.exercise_en: Write a three-scene bedtime story for phone AR where each scene is anchored to a different piece of real furniture. Twist: the last scene happens behind the viewer.
works.exercise_zh: 为手机 AR 写一个三场景的睡前故事，每个场景锚定在不同的真实家具上。变体：最后一幕发生在观众身后。

works.title: Jadu
works.description: A multiplayer AR fighting game in which holographic fighters battle on your floor or desk, controlled from the phone, with players able to walk around and film the fight.
works.description_zh: 一款多人 AR 格斗游戏：全息斗士在你的地板或书桌上对战，由手机操控，玩家可以绕着走动并拍下战斗。
works.idea_en: Bring the fighting-game arena into your real room.
works.idea_zh: 把格斗游戏的擂台搬进你真实的房间。
works.technique: Motion-captured and volumetric characters are placed on detected planes, with networked multiplayer synchronising both fighters' positions in each player's AR view.
works.technique_zh: 动作捕捉和体积影像角色被放置在检测到的平面上，联网多人模式在每位玩家的 AR 画面中同步双方斗士的位置。
works.exercise_en: Build a two-player phone AR game where each player's character stands on the same shared table and can push the other off the edge. Twist: the table's real edge is the ring boundary.
works.exercise_zh: 做一个双人手机 AR 游戏：两名玩家的角色站在同一张共享的桌子上，可以把对方推下桌边。变体：桌子的真实边缘就是擂台边界。

leads.name: Ronald Azuma
leads.why: Author of the 1997 AR survey that defined the field; later led AR storytelling research at Intel Labs. Only talks and keynotes found on video, no demos of his own systems.

leads.name: Johnny Chung Lee
leads.why: Led Project Tango at Google ATAP; earlier famous Wii Remote head-tracking and whiteboard hacks; co-author of XR-Objects.

leads.name: Yuri Suzuki
leads.why: Sound designer (Pentagram partner) behind Sound Bubbles and Convolution Reverb for Everyday Experiments; many spatial sound installations.

leads.name: Tin & Ed
leads.why: Tin Nguyen and Edward Cutting: playful AR and installation artists; Kaleidoscopic Home for Everyday Experiments (video offline since SPACE10 closed).

leads.name: Random Studio
leads.why: Amsterdam experience-design studio; Point and Repair AR prototype for Everyday Experiments.

leads.name: Bakken & Bæck
leads.why: Oslo/Amsterdam studio behind Room Shuffle, Shelve It and Home Applications for Everyday Experiments; Room Shuffle is credited under space10 here.

leads.name: Invisible Roommates (Nicole He + Eran Hilleli)
leads.why: Everyday Experiments AR app that shows home devices as characters; creator nicole-he already in gallery but the Vimeo videos were removed when SPACE10 closed.

leads.name: Raymond Lo
leads.why: Steve Mann's student and co-founder/CTO of Meta (Spaceglasses); uploaded EyeTap X and HDRchitecture demos.

leads.name: Meta Company (Meron Gribetz)
leads.why: Maker of the Meta 1/Meta 2 AR headsets with Steve Mann as chief scientist; hand-interaction demos 2013-2017.

leads.name: Michael Marner & Ross Smith (UniSA)
leads.why: Spatial AR researchers in Bruce Thomas's lab; their main SAR works are already credited under bruce-thomas.

leads.name: Mustafa Doga Dogan
leads.why: Lead author of XR-Objects (Augmented Object Intelligence) at Google; also tangible and fabrication-aware AR work from MIT.

leads.name: Christian Holz
leads.why: ETH Zurich / ex-MSR; co-author of DreamWalker, VRoamer, Mise-Unseen and SeeingVR with Eyal Ofek.

leads.name: Jens Grubert
leads.why: Coburg University; mobile knowledge work in VR/AR, pen-based spreadsheets and physical keyboards in XR with Eyal Ofek.

leads.name: USC World Building Media Lab (Alex McDowell) — Leviathan
leads.why: Leviathan volumetric AR whale demos at CES 2014 with Intel, associated with Ronald Azuma's Intel AR storytelling work.

leads.name: Sonic Healing (FIELD x SPACE10)
leads.why: Later FIELD sound/visual pieces for SPACE10; unclear whether spatial or AR, Vimeo clips only 14 s loops.
